listings.description: This newly constructed estate with an attached 5-car garage in Eanes ISD sits on over an acre in a private cul-de-sac, presenting remarkable value at just $880 per square foot with a 1.4% tax rate. 9117 Brookhurst Cove offers sweeping Hill Country views from its elevated position. Inside, the home welcomes you with stunning herringbone wood floors that set the tone for the immaculate finishes found throughout. Walls of windows frame the surrounding landscape, creating a seamless connection between the refined interiors and the natural beauty beyond. The expansive primary suite is positioned to capture exceptional views. Rejuvenate in the thoughtfully designed, luxurious ensuite bathroom featuring dual sinks, a soaking tub, and an oversized walk-in closet with an additional washer and dryer for enhanced convenience. A dedicated office with custom built-ins provides an elegant work-from-home space. The home is also equipped with a Savant starter package with a speaker and 12 smart switches. Every detail reflects craftsmanship and comfort at the highest level. Designed for both relaxation and entertaining, the residence features resort-style amenities including a theater, yoga studio, pool and spa, putting green, firepit, and an outdoor kitchen ideal for hosting year-round. The attached garages provide space for five cars, accommodating both everyday needs and enthusiast collections. Located in the prestigious Seven Oaks neighborhood, this exceptional property offers luxury living in one of West Austin's most sought-after settings. *Tax and assessed values are estimates for illustration purposes only. All figures should be independently verified. MORE at SevenOaksEstate.com

Experience the ultimate Austin lifestyle in this exquisite modern home, perfectly situated in Barton Hills, one of the city's most desirable neighborhoods. The residence features four spacious bedrooms, a dedicated office, and a massive upstairs den. The modern aesthetic is showcased by an exterior mix of metal, stucco, and limestone. Inside, find concrete and European Oak wood flooring paired with granite and Caesarstone countertops. The chef's kitchen is equipped with top-of-the-line appliances from Sub-Zero Wolf to Thermador. Floor-to-ceiling windows flood the open floor plan with natural light and seamlessly integrate the interior with the pool and private backyard, making it great for entertainment. Enjoy sweeping views of the adjacent greenbelt from your property. Upstairs, a massive den offers a versatile retreat. Beyond the home, you gain access to the unparalleled Barton Hills lifestyle. The community is known for its supportive nature, its proximity to the amazing greenbelts, and the highly-regarded Barton Hills Elementary School. Located minutes from Downtown, Barton Springs, Zilker Park, and ACL Festival, this property epitomizes luxury living in a truly exceptional setting. All values are approximate and to be verified.

Crafted by Paradisa Homes, this sophisticated residence epitomizes modern luxury and timeless design. Thoughtfully composed, the home offers 5 spacious bedrooms and 4 beautifully appointed full baths, including a private second-floor en-suite and a versatile media/flex space to accommodate evolving lifestyle needs. Rich wide-plank oak flooring extends gracefully throughout, paired with 8' solid-core doors, refined finishes, and expansive Andersen windows and doors that bathe the interior in natural light while enhancing energy performance. Every interior wall along with the insulated garage contributes to a distinctly quiet and comfortable living environment. Designed for elevated living, the home features full smart technology integration, including pre-wiring for indoor/outdoor surround sound, Cat6 Ethernet, controlled lighting, security camera capability, and EV charging. The outdoor experience is equally impressive. Beyond the interior, a private fully fenced sanctuary awaits, showcasing a heated pool and spa with premium Pentair equipment, a dedicated pool bath, and a covered patio complete with a fully equipped outdoor kitchen, a seamless extension of the home's entertainment spaces. Automatic sprinklers with bubblers ensure the beautifully landscaped grounds are effortlessly maintained. Completing this exceptional offering are a large utility room with sink, walk-in pantry, tankless water heater, and an insulated 2-car carport designed for durability and convenience.

Introducing a standout Paradisa-built residence that pairs elevated design with everyday livability. 5 bedrooms, 4 baths, and a layout crafted for both quiet comfort and effortless entertainment. While inside, wide-plank oak flooring and premium finishes create a clean, timeless backdrop throughout. A sunlit flex space adapts to your needs, media room, home gym, studio, or executive office. The primary suite delivers true retreat vibes with a spa-inspired bath wrapped in marble finishes. Outside, enjoy a fully fenced backyard oasis featuring a covered patio and outdoor kitchen, plus a heated pool and spa powered by Pentair equipment with smartphone control. An automatic irrigation system with integrated bubblers keeps the landscaping thriving year-round. Built for modern, connected living, the home is pre-wired for full smart-home integration including EV charging, indoor/outdoor surround sound, security cameras, Cat6 Ethernet, and programmable lighting. Additional highlights include 8-foot solid-core interior doors, full insulation in all interior walls for improved efficiency and sound reduction, and premium Andersen windows and doors that enhance both performance and style.

Built by Paradisa, step into a home where every detail has been intentionally crafted for comfort, performance, and style. This 5-bedroom, 5-bath modern residence delivers a rare blend of architectural refinement and everyday livability complete with two private en-suite retreats on the second floor. Wide-plank oak floors guide you throughout the open and airy layout, where natural light pours in through Andersen windows and doors. A sleek fireplace anchors the main living space, setting the scene for relaxing evenings and memorable gatherings. For those who value seamless living, this home is built smarter: full AV pre-wire for whole-home audio, indoor/outdoor surround capabilities, security camera network wiring, Cat6 Ethernet, lighting control integration, and EV charging already in place. Even the walls, every single one, including interior walls and the garage are fully insulated for superior climate control and sound separation. The outdoor experience is equally impressive. A covered patio extends the living space into the backyard, where an outdoor kitchen and a sparkling heated pool and spa powered by Pentair equipment create a personal resort. A dedicated pool bath and fully fenced yard add convenience and privacy, while the landscaping is kept lush by automatic sprinklers with bubblers at every plant. Storage and functionality shine with a walk-in pantry, oversized utility room with sink, and a flex/media room ready for movie nights or a private office. The 3-car garage is finished with commercial-grade epoxy flooring, and the tankless water heater ensures endless hot water on demand.

This stunning 5-bedroom, 5-bathroom residence by Paradisa showcases a seamless blend of modern design and refined luxury. A private casita with a full bath provides an ideal retreat for guests, while the main home is thoughtfully appointed with premium finishes throughout. Wide-plank oak flooring enhances the open layout, complemented by soaring vaulted ceilings that create an airy and inviting atmosphere. Built with both comfort and efficiency in mind, the home is fully insulated-including the garage-and features 8' solid-core doors for superior privacy and elegance. Oversized Andersen windows and doors fill the interiors with natural light while offering exceptional durability and style. The resort-inspired backyard is designed for year-round enjoyment, complete with a covered patio, fully equipped outdoor kitchen, and a heated pool and spa-all easily managed through the Pentair app. Lush bamboo landscaping and a fully fenced yard with automatic irrigation and plant bubblers ensure beauty with minimal maintenance. Tailored for modern living, the home is prewired for full smart home integration, including surround sound (indoors and outdoors), security cameras, CAT6 Ethernet, and app-controlled lighting. A versatile loft offers flexible space for a game room, secondary living area, or home office, while a spacious utility room with a built-in mudroom enhances everyday convenience. The primary suite opens directly to the outdoor living area, creating a seamless connection between indoor comfort and outdoor leisure. Even the finished two-car garage reflects the home's attention to detail, featuring commercial-grade epoxy flooring and MyQ technology for smart access.

Built by Paradisa, this exceptional 5-bedroom, 4-bath residence harmoniously combines timeless elegance with modern sophistication. The open-concept layout creates an inviting atmosphere, seamlessly blending luxury and comfort throughout. At the heart of the home, the gourmet kitchen is a chefs dream, featuring a 48 Thermador cooktop, professional Bosch Series appliances, a wine refrigerator, and striking quartzite countertops. The kitchen flows effortlessly into the dining area and the warm, welcoming living room, where expansive folding glass doors frame serene views of the pool and allow for a seamless indoor-outdoor living experience. The first-floor primary suite serves as a refined private retreat, appointed with custom oak cabinetry, designer tilework, a soaking tub, and thoughtfully placed windows that fill the room with natural light while ensuring privacy. The main level also includes a guest bedroom and a dedicated pool bath, ideal for hosting visitors in comfort. Upstairs, a full guest suite and a versatile loft offer flexible space for a home office, media lounge, or additional living area. Designed for both relaxation and entertainment, the outdoor living area features a covered patio that feels like an extension of the home, a fully equipped outdoor kitchen, and a heated pool and spa. Lush, professionally landscaped grounds are maintained with an automatic irrigation system and integrated plant bubblers for year-round vibrancy. Additional highlights include pre-wiring for smart home automation, surround sound, exterior security cameras, Cat6 Ethernet wiring, and energy-efficient enhancements such as foam insulation in the exterior walls, garage, and roof, along with batt insulation in all interior walls.

Experience this exquisite five-bedroom house with pool and hot tub! The epitome of luxury, meticulously crafted to captivate as you enter the bright, airy, modern open-concept design, complete with high-end custom finishes throughout, creating a sense of sophistication and elegance. With its impressive stone fireplace, the ample living space provides a breathtaking view of the private outdoor oasis that showcases a heated pool and spa and a spacious side yard perfect for entertaining or unwinding in solitude. The kitchen is a masterpiece, with a large center island, rift wood oak cabinets, and top-of-the-line Thermador professional appliances, making it the ideal place for hosting any occasion. The butler pantry, located adjacent to the kitchen, has an additional dishwasher and prep space for all your culinary creations, making entertaining a breeze. This home is equipped with full intelligent home automation, Lutron lighting, pre-wired for surround sound, exterior security cameras, Cat6 ethernet wiring, and security, providing the utmost safety and convenience. The house is built with foam insulation in the exterior walls, garage, roof, and batt insulation in all interior walls, ensuring maximum energy efficiency and reducing environmental footprint. Other eco-friendly features include a highly efficient HVAC system with Aprilaire, tankless hot water, automatic irrigation with a bubbler for plants, and a complete gutter system, making luxurious sustainability an accurate statement. Conveniently located near downtown, with effortless access and proximity to trendy dining, shopping, highly acclaimed schools, and parks, this home harmoniously blends Austin City Life with tranquility. Take advantage of this opportunity and schedule your showing today!

Paradisa invites you to experience the refined living at Westover, a stunning Tarrytown retreat where elegance, privacy, and modern sophistication converge. Set within a private gated compound, this extraordinary residence welcomes you through a motorized gate and into a world of timeless design and elevated comfort. Every detail has been thoughtfully curated to provide a luxurious lifestyle within a tranquil, secure setting. Step inside an expansive, light-filled living space anchored by a beautifully crafted fireplace, perfect for intimate gatherings or cozy evenings. Anderson windows and doors flood the home with natural light, highlighting the exquisite finishes and architectural detail throughout. The gourmet kitchen is a culinary showpiece, outfitted with top-of-the-line Thermador professional appliances, a striking wine tower for displaying your finest bottles, and an oversized center island that invites both creativity and conversation. Whether you're preparing a casual breakfast or hosting a grand dinner party, this kitchen is as functional as it is beautiful. Retreat to the sumptuous primary suite, a sanctuary designed for rest and relaxation. The spa-inspired bathroom features a soaking tub, dual vanities, and a luxurious walk-in shower, creating a serene, hotel-like escape. Versatile living continues with an upper-level loft ideal for a home office or lounge, as well as a media/flex room perfect for movie nights or entertainment in style. Outside, your private backyard oasis awaits. A shimmering pool invites you to unwind under the sun, while the expansive patio offers the perfect setting for serene evenings under the stars. Additional features include a spacious three-car garage, full smart home automation, pre-wired for surround sound, exterior security cameras, Cat6 ethernet, and a security system. Built for efficiency and comfort, the home also includes foam insulation in the exterior walls and garage, and batt insulation in all interior walls.

Paradisa invites you to our newest Westlake retreat that exudes elegance and offers a luxurious living experience. Barn Swallow presents a unique combination of spaciousness, modern amenities, and sophisticated design. Upon entering, you are greeted by the expansive living area. This inviting space boasts a cozy fireplace that creates a warm ambiance during cooler evenings. Large windows flood the room with natural light, showcasing the home's tasteful finishes and attention to detail. The full gourmet kitchen is a chef's dream, equipped with Thermador professional appliances and featuring a wine tower to store and display your prized collection. With ample counter space and a center island, this kitchen provides an ideal setting for culinary creativity and entertaining guests. The master suite is a private retreat with a spa-like en-suite bathroom featuring a soaking tub, dual vanities, and a walk-in shower. One of the highlights of this home is the loft area, perfect for use as a home office or additional living space. Additionally, the flex/media room provides a dedicated space for enjoying your favorite movies and shows in the comfort of your own home, complete with a wet bar. Step outside to discover a backyard oasis designed for relaxation and entertainment. The sparkling pool beckons on hot summer days, while the spacious patio is ideal for al fresco dining and lounging. Further enhancing this property is a three-car garage, providing ample parking and storage options. A crushed concrete pad reinforces the foundation, ensuring long-term stability and security. Bold and architectural from the outside, the home opens into an interior that feels airy and elegant. Soaring ceilings, graceful arches, and natural light fill the space while maintaining privacy from neighbors. A gas fireplace adds warmth casting a soft glow that sets the tone for gatherings. Every cabinet was thoughtfully designed with integrated trash pull-outs, utensil dividers, and concealed organization. The main-floor primary suite is framed by tranquil pool views and features antique gold Rohl fixtures, a freestanding soaking tub, and honed Calacatta Gold Bardiglio marble floors. A custom vanity and brass-framed reeded glass doors add a refined, tailored finish. Step outside to a covered porch and private turf backyard with a serene pool-an ideal setting for weekend lounging or sunset dinners. An eight foot privacy fence encloses the space, while soffit downlighting and step illumination create a warm glow long after the sun goes down.

Each secondary bedroom includes its own private full bath, offering comfort and privacy for family or guests. At the center of the home, the chef's kitchen is outfitted with premium stainless steel Thermador appliances, including a built in gas range, double ovens, and a fully integrated refrigerator, delivering both performance and sleek design. A detached guest studio adds exceptional flexibility with its own bedroom, bathroom, living space, and covered porch, ideal for guests, a home office, or income producing potential. Both the main home and studio overlook a heated in ground pool surrounded by low maintenance turf, creating a resort style setting perfect for entertaining. All of this, just a short stroll to neighborhood favorites including Uchi, Alamo Drafthouse, Zilker Park, and the best of South Lamar. Zilker living at its finest. Privacy, walkability, and timeless design in one of Austin's most coveted locations.

En suite bedrms w/ custom closets, marble/porcelain tile baths. Finished 3rd flr w/ blt-in twin beds, tv mount, half bath. Waterwall pool, open & covered terraces w/ multiple gathering areas, faux turf.

Welcome to 2920 Georgetown, a beautifully crafted, new construction residence by renowned local builder, Churchill Homes Inc. With an exceptional, central West University location, the home is tucked into the heart of the neighborhood yet is MINUTES to RICE VILLAGE and WEIR PARK. This gorgeous home CHECKS EVERY BOX with 4 bedrooms each with their OWN BATHROOM. Plus GAMEROOM, STUDY, open plan kitchen, living, dining, breakfast area and MUD ROOM. The home enjoys gorgeous natural light thanks to the entire rear of the home being mostly windows complete with double sliding doors. The magazine worthy kitchen features custom, onsite built cabinetry, Quartz countertops, Wolf 6 burner gas range and Sub Zero Refrigerator. 5 inch White Oak hardwoods throughout the home with porcelain tile in the bathrooms. 10 foot ceilings add to the feeling of light and spaciousness. Tankless water heaters, elevator capable, glass and iron front door, outdoor kitchen and more! All per seller

Stunning 4-bed, 3.5-bath custom home in prestigious Brykerwoods Estates. Zoned to top-rated SBISD schools, this residence combines refined design w/ everyday comfort. Features include hardwood floors, open chef's kitchen with new GE Monogram appliances, custom cabinetry, and stone and granite surfaces. The family room centers around a stunning carved stone gas fireplace and flows to the formal dining with a brick-barreled ceiling. Upstairs, the serene primary suite offers a spa-like jacuzzi bath, boutique closet, and stone fireplace. Enjoy a shiplap-accented game room, guest suite down, and professionally landscaped backyard with custom pool/spa, turf, and covered loggia with outdoor TV. High-end upgrades include new roof, HVAC, lighting by Visual Comfort, solid brass hardware, fresh paint, custom garage floor and enhancements, and 3 elegant fireplaces throughout. All TV's, custom window treatments/drapes & chandeliers convey w/ the home. A rare blend of quality, beauty, and location.

Designed by the renowned Reagan & Andre Architecture Studio, this stunning new construction by TKT Building Group showcases a slurried brick exterior & beautifully curated outdoor spaces by Gregory/Henry Landscapes. Large steel & glass doors invite you into interiors lined with Moroccan limestone floors & walls of thermally broken steel windows that flood the living, dining, & upstairs den with natural light. A custom limestone mantle frames the living room fireplace, while the chef's kitchen impresses with a leathered quartzite waterfall island, Thermador appliances, & custom rift-cut walnut cabinetry. The luxurious primary suite includes a sitting area, a spa-like marble bath, & dual oversized walk-in closets. All secondary bedrooms feature ensuite baths & walk-in closets. Additional highlights include a scullery kitchen, hidden bar, elevator closet, & a summer kitchen beside one of the home's three covered porches. A masterclass in timeless elegance & sophisticated design.

Spectacular newer construction in sought-after Fonn Villas offering 6, 400+ SF of luxurious living. This 5-bedroom, 6-bath home features en-suite baths in every bedroom, plus a powder room and full pool bath. Soaring ceilings and expansive windows fill the home with natural light. The chefs kitchen boasts a large island, custom hardwood cabinetry, Thermador appliances, and 30 side-by-side fridge and freezer. A 300+ bottle temperature-controlled wine cellar adds sophistication. A downstairs guest suite includes a private bath, and an elevator near the stairs ensures easy access to the second floor. The expansive primary suite features marble floors, a spa-like shower, dual water closets, his-and-her vanities, and an extraordinary walk-in closet with custom built-ins and island. The lush backyard retreat includes a private saltwater pool perfect for entertaining. Additional highlights: whole-home water-cooled generator and comprehensive water filtration system. Frostwood, MMS, MHS.

Just blocks from Rice Village, this stunning Southampton home combines luxury, comfort & thoughtful design. Soaring 11ft ceilings & floor-to-ceiling windows fill the space w/ natural light, creating a bright, open, & inviting atmosphere. The well-designed floor plan centers around a gourmet kitchen featuring a large island, quartz countertops, custom cabinetry & Thermador appliances. The kitchen flows into the spacious living area & formal dining. Custom built-in cabinets in the living room, office, & game room add to the home's versatility. Upstairs features 4 bedrooms including a generously sized primary suite w/ large walk-in closet. The built-in grill, fan, & speakers on the covered lanai make it ideal for year-round entertaining. Additional highlights include mudroom, 2 EV charging hookups, smart-home tech throughout, & abundant storage throughout. Elevator-ready, PEX plumbing, 2 surround sound systems, Reverse Osmosis & Wine & Beverage fridge. Room for a pool!!!

This stunning Acadian-style custom home exudes Southern charm w/its grand plantation front porch & impeccable craftsmanship, tucked away in the heart of prestigious Piney Point. The formal dining room features a built-in buffet & dramatic floor-to-ceiling windows that flood the space w/natural light. The gourmet kitchen boasts custom cabinetry, granite countertops, & high-end stainless-steel appliances, opening seamlessly into a spacious family room adorned w/travertine floors, custom built-ins, & a cozy fireplace. French doors lead out to the backyard w/a charming fountain. Paneled study w/custom built-ins provides a quiet retreat, while the luxurious downstairs primary suite features a sitting area, dual marble bathrooms, and two oversized walk-in closets. Upstairs, a versatile game room provides space for entertainment, & an unfinished 460-square-foot bonus room over the garage offers endless potential for customization. New roof 2025 and Cummins generator.

Experience luxury living in this custom estate near Memorial Park where contemporary elegance meets timeless design. This two-story residence offers 4/5 bedrooms, 5 baths, soaring ceilings, & walls of windows that flood the interior w/ natural light. The grand living area opens to a private backyard oasis with plunge pool/spa, serene water feature, summer kitchen & covered patio w/ fireplace. The chef's kitchen is appointed w/ commercial-grade Viking appliances, oversized island, walk-in pantry & sleek custom cabinetry. The 1st floor primary is a sanctuary w/ backyard views, soaking tub, glass-enclosed shower, dual sinks, vanity & dreamy walk-in closet. Add'l features incl. a home office, expansive gameroom/flex space, a plethora of storage & whole home generator. Enjoy easy commutes Downtown or to the Galleria area. Your active lifestyle awaits being near Memorial Park's golf course, premier trails & the scenic Eastern Glades - while just minutes from Houston's top dining & hotspots.

Outstanding McVaugh Custom home on one of the nicest lots on the Fred Couples designed course. Features include a casita, firepit, wine room, large veranda, recently remodeled kitchen with Wolf Appliances, Pella Windows, whole house generator, mosquito control, all window coverings, wired for sound system (system in place and functional), external gas connection, outdoor fireplace, patio, heated pool with attached hot tub, area park, picnic area, playground, basketball court, island with cooktop, pots and pans drawer, undercabinet lighting and home comes fully furnished with a few exclusions. House also features a 100% backup generator.

Nestled on a private street in Memorial Glen. Exquisite 5 BR/5 BA blends elegance & functionality, w/ endless custom features such as 11 ft ceilings, kerfed windows/doors, white oak floors, & designer wallpaper. Large kitchen opens to family room w/ paneled Thermador appliances, McCaw cabinetry, quartzite countertops w/ oversized island. Adjacent dining room w/ dry bar, opens to large outdoor patio through beautiful french doors, ideal for entertaining. Outdoor patio has full outdoor kitchen leading to pool, fire pit area and turfed yard. Secondary bedroom with full bath downstairs in addition to Primary suite. Large Primary suite is a true retreat w/expansive windows and coffered ceiling. Upstairs are 3 secondary bedrooms with full ensuite bathrooms, game room with dry bar & mini fridge, an exercise room and large ac'd holiday storage room! Full home generator & water purification system. This home has it all. Zoned to highly coveted Rummel Creek Elem, Memorial Middle & Stratford HS.

Perfectly positioned on a charming, tree-lined street in West University, this beautifully designed home built by Belmont Custom Homes is within walking distance of neighborhood parks, grocery stores and restaurants. Top-rated schools and local hotspots are just minutes away. This thoughtfully crafted home checks all the boxesfour spacious bedrooms, each with its own en-suite bathroom, a dedicated study, upstairs game room, and an open-concept for the kitchen, dining and family spaces. Flooded with natural light, the rear of the home has expansive windows overlooking the backyard. Wolf and Sub-Zero appliances, custom built cabinetry and quartz countertops make up this chefs kitchen. Wide plank oak floors thoughout. Finally, outdoor kitchen, patio with pergola and substantial green space complete this amazing home.

Custom residence built by Cunningham Custom Homes and designed by acclaimed Rice Residential Design, nestled at the end of a cul-de-sac in Memorial Meadows. This recently built home features Anderson windows, a Control4 system (prewired with speakers downstairs and outdoors), and an energy-efficient design with foam insulation and a tankless water heater. Enjoy a first-floor media room, second-floor game room, elevator, and a gourmet kitchen with Sub-Zero fridge, Thermador appliances, and custom cabinetry. The temperature-controlled wine room, solid doors, and custom-built-ins add luxury throughout. Outdoor living features a covered patio with a summer kitchen, pool, private backyard, and low-maintenance landscaping. Spacious bedrooms and an attic off the game room offer potential for added square footage. Prime Memorial location close to popular restaurants and shopping in City Centre, and Memorial City. Convenient to major thoroughfares and zoned to top-rated SBISD schools.

Truly one of a kind, this impeccably bespoke residence sits on a corner lot along a historic brick-paved street. A builder, developer and art collector's personal home, designed in collaboration with Ragni Studio. Surrounded by 150-year-old oak trees, the home features zero-edge details, seamlessly merging the interior with the outdoor spaces. The main living area opens to the pool and grass, creating a great room. The second-level primary bedroom floats over the pool below, providing shade while offering sweeping treetop views. Floor-to-ceiling sliding glass doors, bookmatched stone slabs, and a modern white stucco exterior with warm Brazilian walnut Ipe accents elevate the design. The chef's kitchen offers Poliform cabinetry, Calacatta marble, Dornbracht fixtures & Gaggenau appliances. A serene retreat, the home can also act as a gallery, ideal for displaying an extensive art collection. Perfect for both relaxation and entertaining, this home is the epitome of a true urban oasis.

Large point lot offering privacy with no side neighbors, turfed putting green, pool, side yard and covered patio with fireplace. Elevator to all three floors. Enter from the covered front porch through double doors to find beautiful wide plank walnut floors and a wonderful floor plan with generous size rooms. Island kitchen with Quartzite counters, breakfast bar, butlers pantry, double ovens, double dishwashers, Wolf gas range, side-by-side SubZero, walk-in pantry, breakfast room and large office nook perfect for a mud room. First floor paneled study, large dining room and living room with gas fireplace. Second Floor: Primary suite with separate sitting room, terrace with French doors, large bathroom and incredible closet space, two ensuite bedrooms with walk-in closets and laundry room with window, sink and cabinetry. Third floor with an open family room/gameroom with wet bar, fourth bedroom and full bath. Wonderful tree lined neighborhood.

Impeccable 4 bedroom/4.5 bath Heights home situated on a picturesque 11, 872 sf double lot with a pool/spa. From the moment you step inside, youll be captivated by the light-filled, airy ambiance and impressive architectural details including an extra-wide industrial glass and steel staircase, and metal Ram windows. The kitchen boasts a 15+ ft white quartz island, custom cabinetry, built-in Gaggenau refrigerator, beverage fridge, & double ovens. The primary suite is a true retreat w/ a cathedral ceiling & an uber luxurious bath. The 1st floor bedroom w/ ensuite bath is perfect for guests & the oversized mudroom & upstairs gameroom add to the functionality of the floor plan. A 13x10 panoramic harmonic door seamlessly connects the interior to the backyard oasis where you will enjoy the heated pool/spa, spacious deck, gorgeous landscaping, & a full lot of green space! Built for entertaining & walkable to Halbert park, this stunning masterpiece is a rare find in the neighborhood!

A magnificent custom designed home with unparalleled elegance and comfort. Located on coveted street across from a park. It features a gallery entry w/ barreled ceilings & large study w/ built-ins & shelf lighting. A centrally located wet bar w/ a wine fridge & ice maker for effortless entertaining. The open-concept great room & gourmet kitchen boasts high ceilings & expansive windows overlooking the pool. Chef's kitchen features Thermador appliance package with 3 ovens, warming drawer, 2 dishwashers, custom cabinetry & a stunning island. Upstairs, game room w/ built-ins & wine fridge complements the luxurious primary suite w/ spa-like bath & an expansive closet. 4 secondary bedrooms have en-suite baths. Additional highlights include hardwood floors, custom wood shutters, chef's office & mudroom. Covered patio features a fireplace, bar w/ fridge & ice maker, gas grill & a half bath. Elevator-capable. 3-car garage. Minutes from the Med Center, Rice University, museums & Hermann Park.

Elegant Mediterranean stucco home with unsurpassed style in 24-hour guard-gated Royal Oaks Country Club Estates overlooking the 12th fairway. Designed by Robert Dame & custom built by Tuscany Estates, this fine home features a private courtyard with pool & spa + loggia with fireplace & outdoor kitchen + access to private casita/guest suite. Foyer with groin vault ceiling leads to main entry & hall with French doors overlooking the private courtyard. Grand living area with dramatic vaulted beamed ceiling & fireplace is the heart of the home for relaxing, gathering & entertaining - plus a wall of windows overlooking the golf course for serene views day & night. Formal dining room with built-in buffet for serving is opposite a wine closet with decorative iron door - plus adjacent butler's pantry with wet bar, built-in wine chiller & under-counter refrigerator. Stunning island kitchen with vaulted beamed ceiling & granite counters is designed for multiple cooks - prep sink in island, double ovens, microwave, dishwasher, 6-burner gas cooktop with decorative hood over vent. And the adjacent breakfast room is ideal for casual dining, with access to the large covered terrace. A private primary bedroom suite is on the 1st floor - plantation shutters at windows overlooking the golf course, plus a private door to the rear covered terrace. A stunning primary ensuite bath is beautifully appointed with jetted tub, oversize separate shower, double vanities - plus 2 large walk-in closets with built-ins. A 2nd stairway in the primary wing leads to a private study, with balcony overlooking the golf course. A grand curving staircase with decorative iron railing leads to the 2nd floor. There is a spacious casual living area/game room, and adjacent home office/study area with built-in work spaces & cabinetry. There are 3 secondary bedrooms & 2 full baths upstairs - off a wide hallway with a charming window seat. Joining the private membership Royal Oaks Country Club is optional for residents. The Club offers several levels of membership - from social for dining & activities to swim/tennis & fitness to full golf memberships.

Fall in love with this beautifully updated Briargrove home, complete with luxurious upgrades & a sparkling pool! Inside, gleaming wood floors, oversized windows, & elegant moldings exude timeless charm. The formal dining room shines with a stunning chandelier & offers direct access to the butlers pantry, while the versatile formal living room/home office features built-ins & refined details. The bright family room showcases a striking fireplace, large built-ins, & French doors that open to the backyard oasis. The chefs kitchen impresses with quartz counters, white cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, & a breakfast nook. A flexible media room downstairs offers the option for an additional bedroom. Upstairs, the serene primary suite boasts a vaulted ceiling with wood beams & a spa-like ensuite bathroom. A game room & 3 additional bedrooms ensure space for everyone. Step outside to the backyard retreat, featuring a covered patio with a fireplace, an outdoor kitchen, & a private pool.

listings.address: 1118 Anne St, Spring Valley Village, TX 77055
listings.description: JBD Builders newest masterpiece! Stunning new construction in favored Spring Valley Village! Elevated luxury and style with soaring ceilings and expansive rooms, offering on-trend grandeur. A stately study with fireplace sets the tone for sophistication. Both kitchen and living (with second fireplace) under towering ceilings, flow seamlessly to the covered patio, outdoor kitchen and fabulous poolultimate indoor-outdoor entertaining. A giant window behind a soaking tub adds modern drama to the exquisite bath in the lofty primary suite with massive custom closet. Well-appointed, the kitchen has sleek White Oak cabinetry, full-height wall tile, top-tier appliances and a full catering pantry. A butler's pantry with wine column and cabinetry connects dining and great room. Guests enjoy privacy with a first floor guest suite. Second floor features a wide landing with study area, laundry room and game room. All bedrooms are en-suite with walk-in closets. Private police & fire, SBISD schools

This exquisite Spanish-style custom home in Spring Branch is set on a spacious 39, 962 SF gated corner lot, featuring a motor court and two garages. Enter to find a grand great room with views of the saltwater pool and fully equipped summer kitchen, complete with a Wolf gas grill. To the right, the chef's kitchen includes a Subzero refrigerator, freezer, wine cooler, Wolf range with griddle, two sinks, and a generous breakfast area. The main-level primary suite is a private retreat with luxurious bath, walk-in shower and custom closet. Upstairs, two spacious guest suites with one down. The home offers a library/study, for home office. The detached a/c garage can be repurposed for a pool house/game room and holds 6-7 cars. Custom details include, Tabarka tiles, alder doors and cabinets, hickory-pecan wood floors, antique fireplace, Kolbe windows. Recent upgrades with new stucco, clay tile roof in progress, and insulation. This exceptional property combines luxury, and a prime location.

Nestled in sought out Spring Valley Village, this amazing home at 8634 Merlin boasts high-end finishes, top-notch amenities, and exemplary schools. Zoned to exemplary Valley Oaks Elementary, Spring Branch Middle and Memorial HS (buyer to independently verify). The downstairs features a great room, dining area, wet bar w/ wine chiller and amazing cabinetry, study, flex-game room with adjacent full bath, kitchen, and spacious owner retreat. Upstairs, 4 bedrooms with ensuite bathrooms, a game room, and ample storage await. Outside, a summer kitchen, outdoor pavilion, and space for a pool. With high ceilings, RAM Windows, Iron Doors, spray foam insulation, tankless water heater, and Thermador Appliances, this home exudes comfort and style. Explore more on IG @UnikaHomes.

Light-filled, Transitional-style home built by Dorsey Builders. 12-ft ceilings; rift-sawn oak floors; richly-veined marble slab floors & countertops; Thassos baseboards; steel doors/full-length windows; cove ceilings; THG fixtures; linear AC diffusers; AV & SAVANT systems. Study w/ media/book/display cabinet; dining rm w/ stunning breakfront. Enormous open kitchen/breakfast area overlooks patio/pool & features a marble island inspired by the singer Drakes Toronto kitchen; cabinet-front SubZero frig w/ frzer drawers; wine chiller; & Le Cornue range. Family rm w/ sleek fireplace & windows/French drs overlooking summer kitchen/patio/pool. 1st-flr en suite bedrm/flex rm. Primary suite w/ wide balcony; lavish marble-clad bath w/ oversized, double-entry shower, air tub, & double walk-in custom-fitted closet w/ waterfall marble packing island. En suite secondary bedrms w/ walk-in closets. 3rd flr game/flex rm w/ bath; gentlemans retreat w/ bar/kitchenette, bath above garage.

Welcome to 4710 Waring in the highly desirable Afton Oaks area! This stunning home features a brick facade, double iron door, wood columns, and a front porch. High ceilings, soaring windows, and custom iron doors fill the space with natural light. Outstanding features include white oak floors, gas fireplace with plaster mantle, chef kitchen w/Thermador appliances, and custom cabinetry. The primary suite is on the 1st floor, along w/ a study, a bar with tall wine chiller, dining room, family room, kitchen, and one of the two utility rooms. The upstairs boasts 4 bedrooms, 2nd utility, spacious game room, and media theater. Outdoor amenities include a covered patio with summer kitchen, Trellis area, POOL, sprinklers, and a turfed backyard. Three-car garage and carefully curated finishes complete this North/South facing gem! Impeccably maintained (floors and paint recently done). Rooms, Schools, and all information to be independently verified. Pictures w/furniture (2019).

Traditional and contemporary unite in this modern neo-classical residence. All-stop elevator. Soaring ceilings both levels; rich millwork, including magnificent architrave moldings in formal rooms; marble & oak hardwood floors; stone fireplaces; marble surfaces in kitchen and baths; return staircase; extensive pocket doors. Foyer w/ black & white marble tiled floor and barrel ceiling travels to walk-in bar with serving window, antiqued mirror backsplash, chiller, icemaker. Secluded study w/ tall solid double doors. Gathering kitchen/breakfast rm w/ massive island w/ sink; marble/glass backsplash; Wolf range/ovens; Miele steam oven & coffee station; cabinet-front SubZero ref, frz. Family rm w/ wall of French drs to extensive loggia w/ summer kitchen, open patios, pool. Full pool bath. Lavish primary suite w/ marble-clad dual bath w/ double-entry shower, soaking tub, 2 water closets, 2 walk-in bespoke closets. En suite bedrooms w/ custom closets. Media/gameroom; gym w/ mirrored walls.

Located on a quiet, leafy cul-de-sac in prestigious Tanglewood, this 5 bed/5.5 bath modern Georgian style home features an open concept floor plan perfect for family living and entertaining. First floor features a spacious Living Room and Kitchen, Bar with wine storage, Scullery, Dining Room and Study with fireplace, Mudroom, and Guest Suite. Upstairs Primary Retreat features a fireplace, coffee bar, double vanities, freestanding tub, large marble shower, and huge closet with 2 islands. Large Gameroom with kitchenette, spacious Utility Room with Craft Area, and 3 ensuite Secondary Bedrooms. High Ceilings throughout, White Oak hardwood floors, Quartz Luxury Windows, Iron Front and Back Door, custom cabinetry, natural stone countertops, Thermador Appliances, 5 fireplaces, luxury plumbing fixtures, Visual Comfort lighting, and a spacious backyard ready for a pool or generator. Back Patio features a Summer Kitchen and Wood-burning Fireplace. Estimated completion August 2024.

Spectacular recent construction by Laird Custom Homes boasts a sharp transitional style on a spacious lot. 5 Bed/4.5 Bath with a guest suite and separate study on the 1st floor. 2nd floor game room with wet bar. Open Chef's Kitchen features a large Island with high-end quartz counter tops, designer selected fixtures, custom cabinetry, under-cabinet lighting, Thermador kitchen appliances, and a 120 bottle Zephyr dual zone wine cooler. Primary bath features separate vanities, soaking tub, walk-in shower and double over-sized walk-in closets. Exterior features include white designer brick with a custom iron/glass front entry, 2 car tandem oversized garage and a covered patio perfect for outdoor family gatherings. Other features: 11 ceilings on 1st-floor, engineered wood flooring throughout, Low-E windows, Power Shades, bonus ~150SF storage closet on 2nd floor not included in list square footage, additional smart features including EV charger hook up and security system, elevator ready.

Located in the highly sought-after Briargrove neighborhood, north of San Felipe, this custom built home epitomizes charm & elegance. The inviting family room with its cozy fireplace & large windows provides a picturesque view of the sparkling pool, expansive back yard with a fire pit & loggia complete with a summer kitchen- ideal for both relaxation & entertaining. The chef's kitchen features custom cabinetry, copper farmhouse sink, Viking appliances, breakfast bar, breakfast nook & walk-in pantry. Other highlights on the 1st floor include an elegant dining room, formal living, paneled study, wine room, butler's pantry, mud room, 2 car garage w/ work space + 2 car porte-cochre. Upstairs you will find 3 generously sized secondary bedrooms w/ walk-in closets & en-suite baths, media room & work out room. The spacious primary suite offers a serene retreat w/ separate vanities, custom walk-in closets, soaking whirlpool tub & separate shower. Showings will begin Friday, Aug 9th. Owner/Agent

Jeff Paul Custom Homes brings timeless elegance to Hilshire Village. This 5 bed/5 bath home redefines Modern Tudor. Dramatic front elevation w/sprawling windows looking out onto lush landscaping, parapet roof, 8 tall garage entry, cast stone accents & custom front door w/transoms. Guests are greeted upon entry w/curved staircase flooded by light from large window in landing. Off the foyer youll find the expansive Chefs Kitchen flanked by formal living/dining space. Living room features a 16 sliding door, fireplace and 11 ceiling w/exposed beams. Primary bed located just off main living space. Features sitting area, ceiling accent and primary closet just off the spa-style bath. Upstairs find 3 en-suite bedrooms, 2 flexrooms and large gameroom. Entire home spray foamed & prewired for security & A/V. Also included is Wolf/SubZero appliance package, PEX plumbing, 8 tall doors, soft close cabinets, 2 tankless water heaters, exterior sprinklers/gutters/drains, 16 SEER2 Trane HVAC

Just half a block from Memorial Park, this striking custom contemporary home features clean lines, open spaces, and abundant natural light. The chefs kitchen designed by Madeval, has been updated with new quartzite counters, cabinets, a marble waterfall breakfast bar, and top-of-the-line appliances. Large windows offer stunning views of the shimmering pool and the lawns. Numerous patios and decks provide areas for outdoor entertaining. The separate guest villa offers an additional 450 sq ft and includes a den, bedroom, and full bath - ideal for a private study, exercise room or art studio. Other highlights include a well-appointed wet bar, a chic primary bedroom with an updated Madeval closet, updated ensuite bath, spacious secondary bedrooms, two living areas, a game room, and a coveted tandem four-car garage. This home offers a rare opportunity to enjoy luxurious living in the heart of one of Houston's most desirable neighborhoods.

Discover refined living at 7611 Caillet St, a beautifully crafted new construction by the esteemed Olerio Homes. Conveniently located in the desirable Lovers Lane Heights neighborhood, just moments from Inwood Village's shopping, dining, and entertainment options. Nestled on a landscaped lot with with a J-drive entry, this home offers an open, airy layout filled with natural light and designer finishes. Custom white-oak cabinetry and flooring, sleek level 4 drywall, Marvin windows, Visual Comfort lighting, marble flooring, and Emtek Hardware add layers of modern sophistication. The expansive living area flows seamlessly into a covered outdoor living area with a fireplace overlooking a yard fit for a pool. Other features from this thoughtfully curated floor plan feature a first floor Primary Suite, Dining, Powder Bath, and Study. Upstairs you'll find 3 additional bedrooms with ensuite bathrooms and walk in closets, a Game Room with a Wet Bar, and a Bonus Room perfect for an extra office, home gym, or play room. Minutes to DNT, Love Field, and Park Cities.

Stunning NEW construction by Olerio Homes! This modern transitional home is located in the sought-after Lakewood Elementary. Filled with high end finishes including Visual Comfort lighting, Marvin clad windows, foam insulation, level 4 smooth finish walls, 8 ft solid core interior doors, soft close cabinetry, white oak hardwood floors, wood burning fireplace with marble surround and iron front door and stair railing to name a few. The flexible floor plan includes 4 bedrooms, a dedicated office, media and game room. The 1st floor primary suite offers a spa-like bath with a separate tub and shower, double vanities, and a large walk-in closet. Three additional en-suite bedrooms located upstairs. Spacious backyard with room for pool. Enjoy the nearby trails at the beautiful White Rock Lake or head over to the charming shops and restaurants of Hillside Village.

5.99% Own.Fi. available - 714 East 21st Street, another Heights masterpiece, was expertly constructed and offers 4 bedrooms with 4 1/2 baths. Measuring 4,007 square feet, this new construction home boasts an oversized property with all of the custom amenities you have grown to expect from Woodrock Homes such as Thermador appliances, Kohler plumbing fixtures and Jeld Wen windows. The first floor provides a spacious living room, kitchen and dining room that all overlook the sizeable backyard and outdoor kitchen located under the 230+ square foot covered patio. Additional first floor amenities include a private home office/study, numerous storage closets creating a very functional home as well as a massive garage. On the second floor, there are 3 secondary bedrooms, each with an en suite bathroom, a spacious game room with a beverage bar and dedicated storage/audio/visual closet as well as an 800SF master suite with a breathtaking bathroom and large wardrobe closet.

listings.address: 3429 Bryn Mawr Dr, University Park, TX 75225
listings.description: Introducing a remarkable new build on a spacious 70x160 lot in the heart of University Park, a short stroll to UP Elementary and Caruth Park. Crafted by renowned builder Colby Craig Homes & architect Richard Drummond Davis, this stunning residence offers 5 bedrooms with 5.3 baths across an expansive 7, 025 square feet, showcasing an unparalleled level of craftsmanship and meticulous attention to detail, highlighted by custom millwork, museum finished walls, natural oak flooring and designer finishes throughout. The French Transitional facade boasts a striking combination of clean white Austin stone with cast stone accents, copper gutters, a Samaca slate tile roof, Bevolo gas lanterns, Lincoln windows, and elegant iron and glass front doors. The main floor is thoughtfully designed for entertaining, featuring formal living spaces, a wet bar, and an expansive great room that opens to a gourmet kitchen with Taj Mahal quartzite, a waterfall island, 60-inch Wolf range with a bold vent hood, dual dishwashers, a steam oven, and Sub-zero refrigeration and wine columns. Upstairs, you will discover five bedrooms, each with its own ensuite bath, along with a generously sized game room complete with built-in bunk beds. The primary suite features heated marble flooring, a steam shower, dual wash-lets, and dream closet with custom lighting. Outside enjoy over 350 sf of covered patio space equipped with a summer kitchen, fireplace, pool bath, remote-controlled shades, ceiling-mounted heaters, and a resort-style pool with spa surrounded by lush, low-maintenance turf. Additional details include 11-foot ceilings, an elevator, Toto toilets, office, Emtek hardware, Brizo faucets, a whole-home HVAC scent system, and Lutron lighting. March 2026 Completion.

Featured on the AIA Home Tour in 2020, this architect-designed contemporary home combines the finest in design, craftsmanship, and setting. Located in the desirable Hockaday Neighborhood, and designed and built by acclaimed architect Doug Guiling, AIA, and completed in 2018, this architectural masterpiece sits gracefully on a lush creek lot along iconic Strait Lane. This exceptional home was thoughtfully designed to capture the serenity and beauty of its natural surroundings, with expansive walls of glass and custom Mondrian-style windows that flood the interior with light and frame picturesque views of the mature trees, beautifully designed landscaping, and the tranquil creek beyond. A striking oversized entry door opens to reveal a curated art wall and a breathtaking two-story great room. listings.description: With views overlooking White Rock Lake Park, this architect-designed modern custom in The Peninsula presents a rare opportunity for private, design-driven living at 9211 E Lake Highlands Dr. Surrounded by nature and shaped by shifting light throughout the day, the home delivers a peaceful living experience deeply connected to its natural setting. Designed through a collaboration between a Seattle-based architect and local Dallas designers and builders, the residence reflects a design-forward approach rooted in site-specific architecture. Clean lines, curated materials, and thoughtful spatial planning shape everyday living, complemented by expansive glass and clerestory windows that fill the interiors with natural light. The home is carefully integrated into the natural hillside topography, with terraces and pathways reinforcing the connection between architecture and landscape. Living spaces unfold through intentionally defined zones anchored by a central courtyard and a private pool with a mosaic-tiled water element, creating a seamless connection between the home and its surroundings. Construction quality is a defining feature, highlighted by a Pier & Beam foundation drilled to some 20 to bedrock and engineered for long-term durability. A layered subfloor system, modern materials, and energy-conscious building practices further enhance performance and longevity. Lighting design enhances both form and function, with a professionally designed Lutron preset system that earned an IES Illumination Design Award of Merit. Custom Emtek hardware, Milgard metal windows, expansive sliding doors, and organic white quartz stone countertops contribute to the homes refined elegance. New Surestone composite decking enhances the courtyard and walkways with superior stability and traction, while Karndean Vulcano luxury vinyl tile adds a stone-inspired look with waterproof performance and comfort underfoot. A separate office structure offers flexible space for work or studio use.

On an oversized corner lot in the heart of beloved Vickery Place, this fully remodeled Tudor blends timeless curb appeal with a breathtaking, design-forward interior. Behind the storybook brick faade, youll find a home thats been thoughtfully reimagined from top to bottom, complete with Taj Mahal quartzite countertops, wide-plank wood floors throughout, and a layout built for both everyday comfort and effortless entertaining. The showstopping kitchen is the true heart of the home, wrapped in custom cabinetry, designer lighting, and a stunning wall-to-wall Taj Mahal backsplash. A generous island anchors the space, offering seating, storage, and the perfect prep zone for gatherings. Additional upgrades include a built-in paneled refrigerator, a luxury gas range, integrated wine fridges, brass hardware, and a charming pass-through window that connects directly to the backyard bar for indoor-outdoor living at its best. The natural light in this home is exceptional - every room feels airy, warm, and inviting, with windows framing the lush landscaping outside. Out back, your private retreat awaits. A sparkling pool with a raised waterfall spa is surrounded by mature trees, stone pathways, and multiple spaces to dine, lounge, or unwind. The covered patio offers shade year-round and includes a mounted TV and ceiling fan, perfect for game days or quiet mornings by the water. The detached garage with an upstairs space, currently used for storage, has AC, plumbing, and electricity in place, offering potential for a future guest suite, office, studio, or pool house, an easy opportunity to add livable square footage and value. Located on a corner lot just moments from the best of Lower Greenville, Henderson, and all the character-filled streets that make Vickery Place one of Dallas most loved neighborhoods, this home is truly special, thoughtfully upgraded, move-in ready, and filled with details you simply wont find anywhere else.

Elegantly sophisticated new construction by Avant Group in the heart of Midway Hollow. This modern residence showcases refined design with warm tones and designer curated finishes throughout. The two-story entry creates an immediate sense of openness, leading into the spacious living room with white oak hardwoods, a sleek gas fireplace, and large windows overlooking the backyard. The open kitchen features Mykonos Quartzite atop custom cabinetry, a 48in built-in Caf refrigerator, Caf gas range, dry bar with wine cooler, floating wood shelves with LED lighting, and an oversized walk-in pantry with additional cabinetry and chopping-block prep area. The first-floor primary suite is privately situated and offers a spa-like bath with Ocean Wise Quartzite atop the floating double vanity, freestanding vessel tub, oversized rainfall shower, and a large boutique-style closet. Also on the main level are a guest bed with en-suite, statement powder bath with Bianco Giola Marble countertop & splash, and a covered patio ideal for year-round use. Upstairs includes three en-suite bedrooms and a generous game room with a built-in wet bar. Thoughtful design continues throughout with clean lines, abundant natural light, and elevated fixtures. Additional features include Control4 Smart Home wiring, smart lighting, speaker and camera pre-wiring, piered-slab foundation, full foam insulation, two tankless water heaters, and the Maverick 1-2-10 Builders Warranty for added peace of mind. 3826 Seguin Dr delivers modern elegance, quality construction, and timeless Avant Group craftsmanship in a premier Midway Hollow location.

Dont miss your chance to own this stunning single-story new construction in one of Dallass most desirable neighborhoods. Schedule your private showing today! The house may be sold unfurnished; however, all brand-new furniture and custom curtains are available for purchase separately.
