Nestled inside the exclusive hillside gated Champagne Crest neighborhood - a true hidden gem! This property features multiple resort-style outdoor living areas, beach entry pool, three waterfalls, hot tub, fire pit, built-in BBQ, courtyard and a covered veranda ideal for entertaining. The modern Spanish Mediterranean inspired design offers all bedrooms with ensuite full bathrooms, 12ft high ceilings, arched entry's, an enormous chef's kitchen including a butlers pantry, built-in bar, formal dining with china cabinet built-ins, 3 fireplaces YES its all pristine and solid high end construction. The primary suite includes direct patio and pool access, a spa-style bath, large walk in closet with built-in cabinetry and sweeping southwest and sunset views from the jetted bathtub. The detached garage is ideal for use as a work space, gym or flex space for all your hobbies. Pride of ownership abounds in this gorgeous custom built home. Private hideaway surrounded by extraordinary vistas for miles. This property is an entertainers delight and a horticulturists dream with over 26 species of tree's (non certified organically treated). Dual zone AC (2023 improved). A rare opportunity inside Champagne Crest to enjoy privacy, elegance and panoramic Fallbrook scenery in a premier gated community. That countryside feel carries into town-open spaces, big skies, and a sense of tranquility are part of everyday life in Fallbrook. 16 world class golf courses within a few miles, 12 local winery's (Fallbrook Winery and Monserate Winery adjacent). Fallbrook is the avocado Capital of the World with their renowned annual Festival in April.

Tucked away on a quiet cul-de-sac, this inviting home blends comfort, functionality and effortless entertaining. Upon entry you are welcomed into a bright living room featuring a custom bar area that flows out to one of the patios and yard. The well-appointed kitchen opens to the family room that is highlighted with a fireplace and leads out to the backyard. A versatile flex space, between the family room and dining area, offers the perfect setting for a home office, study or play room. A spacious bedroom, three-quarter bath and laundry room complete the thoughtfully designed first level. Upstairs the primary bedroom features an ensuite bathroom with a soaking tub and walk-in closet. Two additional bedrooms and a full hall bath are on the second level. Enjoy the indoor-outdoor lifestyle this home offers with a true entertainer's backyard featuring multiple patios and grassy areas, a sparkling pool and spa, a built-in BBQ, a fire pit and a horseshoe pit. This design allows for your own private oasis for relaxation and memorable gatherings. Updates in 2026: new pool heater, new carpet, new lighting fixtures in all bathrooms, kitchen and dining room and freshly painted interior. Additional amenities include: plantation shutters on most of the windows, an attached 450 sq. ft., 2-car garage with direct access to the home, solar panels and central air and heat.

listings.address: 1219 S Irena Ave, Redondo Beach, CA 90277
listings.description: Welcome to this exceptional Craftsman style home located in the heart of South Redondo Beach! Captivating curb appeal on a beautiful tree-lined street, this large family home warmly welcomes you with a charming covered front porch, classic storybook stone brick walkway and lush landscaping. Gleaming hardwood floors usher you in the entry level where you are greeted by an open concept flow from the front living room / den & dining room with a seamless transition to the chef's kitchen and additional living room toward the rear. The kitchen comes fully equipped with brand new Thermador appliances (still in boxes, ready for install!), granite countertops, and a walk-in pantry. An ideal traditional layout, the second level features 3 bedrooms including a massive master suite complete with a large en-suite bathroom, spa tub, fireplace, 2 walk-in closets & balcony access. Completing this level further are a full guest bath, large laundry room and designated office zone which sits just inside of the large west-facing balcony... fully stocked with sunshine, ocean peeks and salty breezes. Continue upstairs from the balcony to find a most impressive rooftop deck. Stunning 360 degrees panoramic views from Malibu & Santa Monica Bay to Palos Verdes Hills, Redondo Beach and everything in between. A great hosting/entertaining space, or just a private, secluded retreat zone with guaranteed views & sunshine year round! Heading all the way back downstairs, the bottom level of the home feels and lives like an entirely separate living quarters. A large, open living & dining room divides 2 bedrooms, both ensuite with their own private bathrooms ... complete with a full kitchen, private entrance and even a 2nd laundry space with stackable W/D. The sliding glass door cascades tons of light throughout the space and offers great indoor/outdoor flow to the large backyard. There you'll find a charming oasis surrounded by a variety of trees, flowers & plants plus an adorable playhouse / garden shed / art studio. A truly one-of-a-kind home in one of the most highly-sought after neighborhoods in all of the South Bay. Other features include: Attached 3-car garage with storage/organization systems, Central Heating, walk-in pantry, plantation shutters throughout, newer carpet, water filtration system, home security system... A+ LOCATION! Walk/Bike to the beach & Riviera Village.. Coffee Houses /bars/shops/restaurants/boutiques/fitness centers & more ALL at your fingertips. Excellent RBUSD Schools!

listings.address: 1639 Zapotec Dr, South Lake Tahoe, CA 96150
listings.description: Tucked into the quiet beauty of the mountains, this brand new home offers a refined balance of modern design and natural surroundings. Thoughtfully positioned with vacant land on both sides, the home feels both private and connected to its setting. Inside, clean architectural lines, open living spaces and carefully selected finishes create a sense of understated luxury. Large windows invite in natural light and frame peaceful views while the open concept layout is ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. The kitchen serves as the heart of the home designed with contemporary cabinetry, beautiful quartz countertops, a spacious pantry, quality materials and a seamless flow into the main living areas. In addition to the main living room the home also contains a spacious family room with wet bar and bonus area that is perfect for an office, game room, workout room, etc. Bedrooms are designed as restful retreats, offering comfort, space and tranquility. The primary suite provides a relaxing escape with a luxurious bath and private balcony. Throughout the home attention to detail and craftsmanship reflect the benefits of new construction-energy efficient, modern systems and low-maintenance living. Surrounded by mountain air with five decks to take in the scenic beauty, this home offers a rare opportunity to enjoy new construction in a timeless natural setting. Perfect as a full time residence, weekend escape, or long-term investment.

RARE opportunity to own 2 Tuscany inspired homes perched on a hill offering STUNNING 360-degree views from every angle. Situated on just over 2 acres, these Temecula wine country residences exude timeless old-world sophistication. A quiet cul-de-sac location ensures little to no traffic, enhancing privacy and serenity. The security gate creates a DRAMATIC ENTRANCE, guiding you up the estate past lush vineyards and the charming 3 bed residence on the right, arriving at the impressive 4 bedroom main residence on your left. The main home showcases a custom pool w/ smooth PebbleTec finish & elegant glass tile, complemented by a 10 person spa. Host THE BEST soiree w/ your own custom wood fired pizza oven, outdoor wood burning fireplace, & gas firepit designed for unforgettable evenings. Step through custom knotty Alder entry doors and experience soaring ceilings while taking in breathtaking valley views framed by expansive Solarian windows beyond the pool, spa & fire features. The formal dining room is perfectly positioned within the Solarian window setting, ideal for evening entertaining while enjoying sparkling valley lights. Just off the GREAT room adorned with a fireplace is a spa inspired junior suite with full bath, located opposite the office and downstairs powder room. The kitchen features PREMIUM appliances and finishes including a Sub Zero refrigerator, Wolf range oven, two Bosch dishwashers, Wolf microwave, quartz island counter, and handmade Spanish subway tile backsplash. Upstairs~a private 2ndary family room separating the generous Primary Bedroom & luxurious bath from two additional bedrooms and baths. Just off the family room, an OVERSIZED balcony delivers INCREDIBLE VIEWS overlooking the tranquil vineyard. Flooring upgrades include Colonial Collection European oil finish Oak, custom American Oak stair treads, & blend of Quartz, Marble, & Granite throughout. Additional highlights include custom wood cabinetry, solid core interior doors, dual high efficiency AC systems, whole house attic fan, Santa Barbara smooth stucco, gas burning fireplace with flagstone facade and custom live edge oak mantel, authentic clay tile roofing, & integrated sound system. The 2ND home offers 3 beds & 3 baths w/ sweeping San Jacinto Mtn views, stainless steel appliances, quartz counters, & firepit. Drip irrigation keeps annual water bill <1700 for both homes. 40 solar panels cover most if not all usage. FIRE SPRINKLERS AT BOTH HOMES.

Situated in the hills above the Pacific Ocean you will find this stunning 40 acre oasis complete with a custom 2 bedroom/2 bathroom quality constructed home with ocean views and total privacy. This off grid retreat includes oak plank floors, walls of windows, soaring open ceilings and a large south facing deck. Other features to note include a metal roof, radiant in floor heat and an updated photovoltaic solar system with generator. The inviting sanctuary includes 2 detached cabins (one is on the grid and has an electric car charger installed) can be used for workshop, art studio or potential guest unit. Soak in the wood fire hot tub & entertain friends with the outdoor pizza oven. Includes a pole barn for covered parking & storage, citrus, fig & fruit trees and acres of forested land to wander, including down to Roseman Creek. This property has it all. Close to beaches, rivers and the towns of Gualala and Point Arena.

listings.address: 580 Calle Buena Vista, Morgan Hill, CA 95037
listings.description: This well-planned home offers 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, & 1,733 sq ft of living space on a 5,502 sq ft lot. A tiled foyer opens to the living & dining area, where an arched entry, vaulted ceiling, & gas fireplace with mantel create an inviting first impression. The foyer transitions into the family room, which features its own arched entry, vaulted ceiling, recessed lighting, & a sliding glass door to the backyard. The family room connects to the kitchen, ideal for everyday living & entertaining. The kitchen includes granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, & a peninsula breakfast bar overlooking the dining & family spaces. The primary bedroom features a walk-in closet & a glass door with direct access to the backyard. The upgraded primary bathroom offers a walk-in shower with glass enclosure & a separate jetted tub. An interior laundry room with built-in cabinets adds convenience, & the paved backyard offers low-maintenance outdoor space. The attached garage includes built-in cabinetry. The community offers a swimming pool, tennis & basketball courts, kid's play structure, & picnic tables. The property is ideally located near Highway 101 & the Morgan Hill Caltrain Station. It is assigned to highly rated El Toro Elementary School & Ann Sobrato High School.

Perfectly positioned to capture sweeping ocean views, this coastal retreat blends timeless design with a flexible layout built for everyday living and entertaining. The versatile floor plan includes four ensuite bedrooms, along with a private guest house complete with its own entrance and full bath - ideal for hosting visitors, accommodating extended family, or creating a dedicated home office. Once inside, you'll find approximately 1, 000 square feet of outdoor living space, including covered ocean-view verandas, a rooftop deck, and a California Room, providing a variety of spaces to unwind while enjoying the stunning Pacific backdrop. At the heart of the home, the chef's kitchen is designed for both beauty and function, featuring white oak cabinetry, Cambria quartz countertops, Wolf and Sub-Zero appliances, dual dishwashers, an oversized island, and a separate prep kitchen for additional storage and convenience. Expansive folding doors connect the main living area to the California Room, where a fireplace, built-in speakers, and AV hookups set the stage for seamless gatherings and coastal living. The primary suite serves as a private sanctuary, complete with a spa-inspired bath featuring a dual walk-in shower, soaking tub, two water closets, and a private deck framed by ocean vistas. Throughout the home, curated details include hardwood flooring, custom cabinetry, electronic window coverings, and a Control4 home automation system. The resort-style grounds are finished with a pool, spa, multiple fire pits, and beautifully landscaped front, side, and rear yards. Solar power operates at net zero, offering energy efficiency without compromising luxury. Located just minutes from San Clemente's beaches, shops, restaurants, Dana Point Harbor, and world-class resorts, this exceptional property blends coastal elegance and convenience with the added benefit of low HOA dues and no Mello Roos.

POOL! SPA! 3 CAR GARAGE! Welcome to this stunning well maintained home boasting an open layout, soaring ceilings, updated Anderson windows throughout, and beautiful hardwood floors! Entertain in the formal living and dining room with a separate great room complete with a cozy fireplace. Gourmet kitchen offers white shaker cabinetry, granite counters, pantry, island with bar seating, and gas cooktop! On the main floor you will find a full bedroom and bathroom perfect for guests! Secondary bedrooms are upstairs and conveniently located to the hall bathroom. Unwind in the private primary retreat with a sitting area and fireplace! Enjoy the spa like bathroom offering dual sinks, shower, soaking tub, and walk in closet! Outdoor living does not disappoint!! Entertain year round with a covered patio, solar heated pebble sheen pool w/spa, and a charming deck for dining. Oversized garage comes with a workshop area and built in cabinetry! Prime Folsom location with close proximity to Lake Natoma, Palladio Mall, local eateries, nature trails, water sports and more! Welcome Home!

Experience the pinnacle of elevated 55+ living in this exceptional residence located within the prestigious Esplanade at Sommers Bend - a private, gated community known for luxury, lifestyle, and connection. Perfectly positioned on a single-loaded street with no rear neighbors, this home offers rare privacy, sweeping views, and a nearly 18,000 sq ft lot, making it one of the most desirable homes in the neighborhood. Built by Taylor Morrison, this beautifully upgraded Plan 7 showcases over $100,000 in thoughtful enhancements and unmistakable pride of ownership. Designed to live like a single story, the main level features both the primary suite and a secondary suite as well as an additional office space, while the upper level offers an additional guest bedroom, full bath, and versatile recreation space - ideal for visitors or hobbies. The primary suite is a serene retreat, featuring dual vanities, an oversized walk-in shower, and a generous walk-in closet. The open-concept layout is flooded with natural light, highlighted by soaring two-story ceilings and seamless indoor-outdoor flow. The kitchen anchors the home with a large quartz island, premium stainless steel appliances, abundant storage, and a layout that effortlessly connects to the great room and outdoor entertaining spaces - perfect for both everyday living and hosting gatherings. Sliding glass doors lead to a show-stopping backyard - a true extension of the home. Enjoy a California room with a built-in gas fireplace, expansive deck, gazebo, putting and chipping greens, and a full-size private sport court ideal for pickleball or active living. Owned solar and a 3-car garage complete the package. Residents enjoy exclusive access to Esplanade's resort-style, resident-only amenities, including a heated lap pool and spa, state-of-the-art fitness and wellness center, pickleball and bocce courts, outdoor kitchens, fire pits, gardens, and a private clubhouse with lounges, billiards, and kitchen facilities. The community also offers scenic walking trails, manicured paths, and a vibrant social calendar with 25+ resident clubs spanning travel, art, golf, wine, and more. All of this is just minutes from Temecula Wine Country, award-winning restaurants, shopping, Old Town Temecula, and Pechanga Resort Casino. This is more than a home - it's a turnkey luxury lifestyle. For those seeking privacy, views, resort amenities, and refined 55+ living, your best life truly starts here.

Introducing 1820 Bancroft Street, an extremely rare opportunity to purchase a beautiful THREE unit property in one of the most desirable locations in South Park. Thoughtfully redesigned and reimagined, this property features a gorgeous remodeled Craftsman home with a brand new modern duplex in the back. Whether you want a true family compound or a serious cash flowing property, the choice is yours! Featuring new fully owned solar, new plumbing, new electrical, new roofing, new windows, a newly lined chimney, a modern design with stylish fixtures and the list goes on and on! Envisioned around the art of entertaining, you will be greeted by an open floor-plan concept that flows effortlessly from one to the next. From the tastefully designed living room that flows beautifully into the custom kitchen, to the large luxurious bedrooms and artfully crafted bathrooms, one will immediately fall in love with this home! In the back, a stunning duplex awaits! Recently completed, this duplex features breathtaking mountain and city views, designer finishes, a thoughtfully curated floor-plan and more! This home is located walking distance to parks, schools, restaurants, and more yet tucked away in a quaint and quiet street. This is an opportunity you do not want to miss!

listings.address: 130 Lockwood Ct, El Dorado Hills, CA 95762
listings.description: Reserved for those who value privacy, scale, and presence, this extraordinary estate sits at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac on .47 acre with unobstructed views of Downtown Sacramento. Spanning 4,159sf, the home offers highly coveted SINGLE-STORY LIVING, anchored by a luxurious MAIN-LEVEL PRIMARY SUITE, while a discreet upper wing features an expansive loft, bedroom, and full bath ideal for teens, guests, or extended stays. With 4 bedrooms, 4.5 bathrooms + an office, the home blends function and elegance effortlessly. Architectural sophistication meets refined comfort throughout. Wide-plank oak floors, designer lighting, arched doorways, plantation shutters, and expansive windows create a luminous, effortlessly elegant interior. A striking central courtyard blurs the line between indoors and out, while the chef's kitchen makes a statement with professional-grade KitchenAid appliances, double ovens, warming drawer, large quartz island, reverse osmosis water filtration, and concealed butler's pantry with prep sink, perfect for entertaining on any scale. Beyond the walls, the backyard unfolds into a private resort oasis. A newly refinished pebble-finish saltwater pool and spa with basketball hoop and fully equipped outdoor kitchen with built-in BBQ, sink, beverage refrigerators, and ice maker create an entertainer's paradise. A modern pergola with motorized shade screens flows seamlessly into the California room with brick accent wall and TV. A raised lookout patio with fire pit captures PANORAMIC CITY VIEWS, while landscape lighting, citrus trees, and a fenced side yard complete the experience. Ample storage is provided by a large Tuff Shed with workbench and two smaller sheds. The property also delivers cutting-edge efficiency and convenience: an OWNED 12.8kW SOLAR system with 37 panels and DUAL TESLA POWERWALLS, 2 EV charging stations, a 3-car side-by-side garage with epoxy floors and sink hookups, multi-zone Nest thermostats, SmartVent fresh-air ventilation, and Ring security. The massive driveway and expansive lot provide unmatched flexibility, while the home's design maximizes light, flow, and functionality. Located within the highly sought-after Blackstone community, residents enjoy access to a private clubhouse, gym, multiple pools, spa, scenic trails, and year-round social events. This is a rare offering, a residence defined by thoughtful design, extraordinary amenities, and an unrivaled lifestyle that combines luxury, privacy, and timeless appeal.

Rarely available and masterfully reimagined, this beautifully upgraded 5-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom residence in the highly sought-after "The Ranch" community offers the ultimate Irvine lifestyle with the rare benefit of NO HOA and NO Mello Roos. Originally rebuilt from the studs and expanded in 2014, this home feels like a modern estate, featuring a versatile main-level bedroom and 1.5 bathrooms perfect for guests. The interior radiates contemporary elegance with white oak engineered wood flooring, soaring vaulted ceilings, and bright recessed lighting throughout. At the heart of the home, the gourmet kitchen is a showpiece of craftsmanship, boasting a massive waterfall island and high-end Miele and Thermador appliances. No detail has been overlooked in the home's infrastructure, which features Milgard windows and doors installed in 2016, a widened staircase, updated electrical and Pex piping done in 2015, Nest-controlled HVAC, a tankless water heater, and a water softener that runs throughout the inside of the home to outside garden sprinklers. The property is finished with an epoxy-floored garage and a freshly repainted downstairs interior, ensuring it is truly move-in ready. Situated within the award-winning Irvine Unified School District and next to an expansive greenbelt, playgrounds, and local dining, this home perfectly blends modern luxury with a prime, central location.

Located in Encinitas Ranch, just minutes from the coast, golf, and neighborhood trails, this home balances thoughtful design with everyday livability. The backyard is designed for year-round use, with a built-in fireplace, overhead heaters, and spa creating a comfortable setting for evenings at home. The family room flows naturally from the kitchen, anchored by a fireplace with custom built-ins that balance texture and simplicity. Expansive windows draw in natural light while a glass door opens to the backyard creating an easy indoor-outdoor connection. The result is a space that feels open, welcoming, and perfectly suited for gathering with family or hosting friends. At the heart of the kitchen, a statement Wolf six-burner range is framed by artisan tile and a custom wood hood, while the built-in Sub-Zero refrigerator integrates beautifully into the surrounding cabinetry. Quartz countertops extend across a generous island with seating, offering ample space for meal prep, casual dining, or conversation. The primary suite is designed as a private retreat, offering generous scale, layered ceiling detail, and abundant natural light. The space feels open, airy, and quietly refined, with a seamless flow into the spa-like primary bath featuring an expansive dual-sink vanity with extensive storage, a separate soaking tub, and a walk-in shower. Completing the home are three additional bedrooms, each with its own ensuite bathroom, including an entry level bedroom and full bathroom. A Tesla Powerwall in the garage adds a practical layer of energy efficiency. Call to schedule a private showing.

Absolutely stunning and peaceful home. Pristine Contemporary Mediterranean nestled in a charming Lake Balboa neighborhood. Built in 2015 and upgraded in 2019 and 2021. Newly painted exteriors welcome one into this serene home that is sure to check off all the wants on your list. Meditation yoga room off entry, which can be used an an office or playroom. Formal dining room. Open floor plan with the kitchen of your dreams. Quartz island, counters, backsplash, high end appliances: Bosch microwave drawer, Zephyr wine/beverage cooler, Krauss black titanium no scratch sink & a walk-in pantry. Window above kitchen sink overlooks yard and opens to the vast great room. Great room w/ fireplace, built-ins, drapes, dual pane windows and slider that leads to a generous rear yard with privacy hedges. Downstairs bedroom and full bath. Hardwood floors with wide plank baseboards on the first floor. Upstairs features 3 bedrooms, a laundry room, full bathroom and a huge loft that is being used as a gym but is a great additional flex space for home office, media room, play room etc. Spacious romantic main suite w/ two walk in closets. One closet has been remodeled to perfection, including Gucci wallpaper and floor to ceiling mirror for the ultimate selfie. If you can ever leave closet, there is also a soaking tub and dual sink vanity with custom lighting. Property has tankless water heater and solar for low bills all year. The perfect blend of form and function. Garage has direct access to property. Home is not just a place its a vibe!

Like-new, exceptional value. Priced lower than new build. Beautiful single-level home located in the desirable Sea Haven community. Built in 2021 with over $75K in additional upgrades. This 2, 061 sqft residence offers 3 bedrms plus a separate office & 2 full baths on a 5, 135 sqft lot. Bright, open floor plan. Kitchen w/ granite countertops, white shaker cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, and a large center island flows into the dining and great room. LVP flooring throughout most of the home with plush carpet in bedrooms & great room.The primary suite features abundant natural light, a large walk-in closet, dual sink vanity, soaking tub, and Toto washlet toilet. Two additional bedrooms, a full bathroom, mud room, & laundry room. Beautifully built-in desk and bookcase area by California Closets, ideal for a home office or study space. Upgrades include designer custom pantry door, pro-grade garage cabinets, Smith & Noble window coverings, and whole-house water filtration by KIND.Professionally landscaped, low-maintenance paver backyard with built-in planter boxes. Walking distance to the Cove community clubhouse for gatherings and bocce ball. Coastal-inspired living with access to parks, trails, new retail, restaurants, and easy commute access. A must see!

Welcome to one of Serrano Heights' finest view lots, where panoramic city lights, rolling hills, and ocean-to-Catalina vistas greet you from nearly every angle of this meticulously upgraded 4-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom residence. This is not your typical resale. Step inside and rich hardwood floors, designer lighting, and twin electric fireplaces immediately set the tone. The remodeled kitchen commands attention with new cabinetry, elegant countertops, and modern appliances, with a gas rough-in already in place for those who prefer a gas cooktop. The open floor plan makes entertaining effortless, from the formal dining room with butler's pantry to the generous family room that spills into the kitchen and sun-filled breakfast nook. Upstairs, the primary suite is a true retreat. The fully redesigned en suite features an oversized walk-in shower, dual vanities, and a thoughtful 3-way light switch so you never have to leave the comfort of your bed to adjust the lights. Every bathroom in the home has been completely remodeled. Outside, a custom paver patio extends the living space beneath those sweeping views. Programmable Gemstone architectural lights wrap the exterior and are fully controlled from your phone, whether setting the mood for a dinner party, lighting up for the holidays, or adding a layer of security while you're away. Additional upgrades include fresh exterior paint, new sliding glass doors, a rear door with built-in blinds, new A/C compressor and condenser, new hot water tank, and a modernized sprinkler system. Nestled in one of East Orange's most sought-after communities with access to miles of hiking and biking trails, parks, and top-performing schools including Anaheim Hills Elementary, El Rancho Charter, and Canyon High. Minutes to shopping, dining, and easy freeway access. Thoughtfully upgraded, move-in ready, and waiting for its next chapter.

Buyer could not perform, their loss is your Gain! La Cresta, Murrieta Luxury Estate - Elegance, Acreage & Timeless Living Experience elevated living on 5.57 private acres in Murrieta's prestigious La Cresta community. This 3,106 sq ft single-level estate offers 3 spacious bedrooms and 3 baths, masterfully designed with towering 9-foot ceilings, cathedral accents, and luminous designer windows that bathe the interiors in natural light. A chef's kitchen steals the spotlight with granite slab countertops, custom cabinetry, an expansive dining island with sink, and open access to the entertainment-friendly living spaces. Host with style in the formal dining room, unwind in the serene breakfast nook, or relax by the grand stone fireplace. The owner's suite is a retreat of its own - featuring dual walk-in closets, direct patio access, and a spa-inspired bath with oversized soaking tub and dual-head shower. Secondary bedrooms are bright and generously sized, sharing a luxe full bath with impressive soaking tub, tiled walk-in shower and dual craftsmanship sinks. Step outside to your manicured paradise: an 8-ft-deep pool with strung lights, covered patio and additional pergola, lush landscaping, gated entry, panoramic views, and stereo outdoor speakers that set the mood for sunset gatherings. Fruit trees and your own private raised garden beds to created those delicious dishes. Horse lovers will appreciate direct access to scenic riding trails, with gently rolling terrain, and plenty of space for barns, paddocks, or arenas, your horses will thrive in harmony with the land. The expansive acreage and fenced perimeter provide freedom and safety, while panoramic views make every ride unforgettable. Estate includes a paid solar system, 1,000+ sq ft. 3-car garage with storage room, newer generator, reverse osmosis, and onsite well. RV Parking. This is more than a home - it's a lifestyle. Welcome to La Cresta.

listings.address: 1708 Calle De Los Alamos, San Clemente, CA 92672
listings.description: Santa Barbara meets San Clemente in this Spanish Revival estate, set along the canyon's edge on desirable Calle de Los Alamos in the Lasuen enclave. Offering refined living with sweeping ocean, Catalina Island, and sunset views this property has emotion. A private driveway leads to a grand entry surrounded by sculptural olive trees and bougainvillea. Nearly every major room enjoys ocean views, with whitewater vistas from the upstairs primary suite and a dedicated ocean-view office/loft that may serve as an optional fourth bedroom. The primary suite features vaulted and coved ceilings, a private balcony, and a spacious bath with soaking tub, walk-in shower, and walk-in closet. Additional bedroom suite is located upstairs with en-suite bath and upstairs laundry. The main level showcases hickory pecan hardwood floors and an ocean-view chef's kitchen with quartz countertops and backsplash, Wolf range, Viking refrigerator drawers, and a walk-in pantry with custom built-ins. A private downstairs attached casita with en-suite bath and built-in Murphy bed offers flexibility as a guest suite, gym, or studio. Additional features include a gas/wood-burning fireplace, Sonos surround sound, aluminum-clad wood windows, solid-core 8-foot alder doors, high ceilings, all new LED lighting, new carpet, and newer dual-zone air conditioning. Outdoor spaces include two ocean-view patios (one covered), a front patio, and a centered courtyard with tranquil fountain. An oversized three-car tandem garage with 40-amp outlet completes the home. Located in Southwest San Clemente's Lasuen "Lost Winds," with nearby beach access, Leslie Park, sandy beaches, coastal trail, cafes, dining, and world-class surfing. A rare opportunity offering substantial first-level ocean views in an exceptional coastal setting.

listings.address: 5353 Willow Oak St, Simi Valley, CA 93063
listings.description: Welcome to the largest floor plan in the Auburn Hills neighborhood of Hidden Oaks, ideally located in the heart of Simi Valley. This light and bright residence offers approximately 3,251 square feet of well-designed living space with a flexible layout ideal for today's lifestyle. The main level features a full bedroom and full bathroom, perfect for guests or multigenerational living, along with formal living and dining rooms, a spacious family room with gas fireplace, and abundant recessed lighting. The home showcases tile and carpet flooring, custom built-ins, custom window treatments, upgraded light fixtures, and a newly painted interior throughout. The kitchen is thoughtfully designed with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, upgraded cabinetry, a walk-in pantry, and a generous eat-in dining area that opens seamlessly to the family room--ideal for everyday living and entertaining. Upstairs, you'll find four additional bedrooms, three full bathrooms, and a large loft featuring dual built-in desks with storage, creating the perfect space for work, study, or a secondary lounge. The expansive primary suite offers a peaceful retreat with stunning city and mountain views, a walk-in closet, and a well-appointed ensuite bath. The backyard is designed for enjoyment with stamped concrete, fruit trees, and ample space to relax or entertain. Additional highlights include a three-car garage and a desirable location close to parks, schools, shopping, dining, and easy commuter access. A wonderful opportunity to own a spacious, well-appointed home in one of Simi Valley's most sought-after neighborhoods.

listings.address: 143 N LA Esperanza, San Clemente, CA 92672
listings.description: Welcome to your dream coastal retreat - a brand-new custom-built home perched in the hills of San Clemente with panoramic ocean views stretching from Catalina Island to the Dana Point Headlands. This extraordinary residence presents a rare opportunity to own a luxurious ocean-view home without HOA fees and no Mello Roos, just moments from the heart of downtown San Clemente. Imagine starting your day with a short stroll through the charming streets of the Spanish Village by the Sea, grabbing coffee from a local caf, and walking to the beach - all within minutes of your front door. Step inside nearly 3, 000 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space, where an open-concept great room welcomes you with soaring ceilings, natural light flooding through expansive 4-pane windows. The kitchen features shaker-style cabinetry, quartz countertops, a bar counter top with pendant lighting, and a walk-in pantry - all open to a warm and inviting living area with fireplace and ocean views. This home offers remarkable flexibility with 4 bedrooms plus an office (or potential 5th bedroom) and 5 bathrooms, including a full bedroom suite with a separate entrance on the lower level - perfect for guests, in-laws, or a private workspace. Upstairs, the primary suite is a sanctuary in itself, boasting breathtaking ocean views, a private balcony for sunset-watching, an ensuite bathroom with dual vanities, and a spacious retreat area. Two additional ensuite bedrooms with walk-in closets offer comfort and privacy, while a bonus flex room upstairs provides even more options.
