Set on a spacious parcel surrounded by rolling hills and mature oak trees, Lupine Hollow provides privacy, open space, and room to enjoy the outdoors. Built with fire safety in mind, this home is located within Oak Ridge Estates, one of the few neighborhoods on the Central Coast that is Firewise(R) certified. The community's proactive approach to wildfire preparedness, combined with modern building standards and thoughtful site planning, offers an added layer of confidence and long-term value. The home features an all-electric design with high-efficiency heating and air conditioning, along with an integrated solar system to support energy efficiency and lower operating costs. Inside, the open floor plan is complemented by high ceilings, quality finishes, and designer-selected materials, creating a bright and inviting living environment. The primary suite serves as a comfortable retreat with a spa-inspired bathroom and walk-in closet, while large windows throughout the home capture views of the surrounding landscape and bring in abundant natural light. Conveniently located just minutes from Highway 101, Lupine Hollow (lot 69) offers easy access to downtown Atascadero, Paso Robles wine country, and the beaches of the Central Coast. With no HOA, Oak Ridge Estates provides flexibility, privacy, and a rare opportunity to own a new home in one of Atascadero's most desirable communities. Please note: Photos and virtual tour are of a similar home. Finishes and details may vary. Landscaping not included.

Located in the prestigious guard-gated community of The Reserve at Orchard Hills, this exceptional residence was built by the renowned builder Irvine Pacific and features over $250,000 in upgrades. This thoughtfully designed home offers 4 bedrooms, 3 full bathrooms, and a spacious loft, including a highly sought-after main-level bedroom and full bath. The open-concept floor plan showcases expansive windows and abundant natural light throughout. Interior highlights include elegant marble finishes, premium engineered hardwood flooring, custom window treatments, top-tier kitchen and bath cabinetry, and a chef-inspired kitchen equipped with premium Wolf(R) appliances, including a professional-grade 6-burner cooktop. The luxurious primary suite features dual vanities, a soaking tub, and a separate glass-enclosed shower. Upstairs includes three additional bedrooms, two bathrooms with dual sinks, a versatile loft ideal for a home office or media room, and a spacious laundry room with utility sink. Additional features include an attached two-car garage and a beautifully landscaped private backyard designed for effortless entertaining. Residents enjoy resort-style amenities including two pools, spa, clubhouse, barbecue areas, playground, sports courts, and 24-hour guard-gated security.

listings.address: 33300 Sea Forest Dr, The Sea Ranch, CA 95497
listings.description: 3.21 Acre Sanctuary Where Forest Meets Sky! Set at one of the highest elevations on The Sea Ranch, this serene 3.21-acre property offers exceptional privacy, filtered ocean views, and a rare connection to nature. Private trails wind through majestic redwood groves and rhododendrons, leading one past a seasonal spring that feeds lush ferns and tall grasses, and creating a peaceful park-like setting that feels worlds away. Designed by Lisa Dundee AIA to honor its surroundings, the custom home blends timber, glass, and light-filled spaces. Exposed wood framing and expansive view windows frame the forest and sky, while the open living area flows seamlessly to a large covered wraparound porch for effortless indoor-outdoor living. A floating loft accessed by a spiral staircase provides the perfect office, studio, or guest retreat. Recent renovations enhance both style and function, including an expanded kitchen with new cabinetry, granite countertops, tile flooring, and premium appliances: double electric ovens, cooktop, hood, dishwasher, refrigerator, and wine fridge. The great room design features exposed timber framing with soaring ceilings and elongated view windows in the living room. A new propane gas fireplace was added for those chilly evenings. The two bedrooms each feature sitting areas and en suite baths, complemented by radiant heated floors, and a walk-in closet in the primary bedroom. Additional highlights include fiber cement siding, fenced yard, and oversized deep garage. Adjacent to the garage is 375 sq ft of unconditioned space with office, half bath, and storage ideal for hobbies or workshop use. A hot tub, EV charger, 5.8kW solar system, and 20kW battery backup provide comfort and energy efficiency. A rare opportunity to own a private retreat where redwoods, light, and quiet define the Sea Ranch lifestyle.

Just minutes from Sonoma Plaza, this private modern farmhouse blends Wine Country luxury with serene, bucolic surroundings. Beyond your gated entry, a tree-lined drive welcomes you home to an estate designed for both relaxation and entertaining. Inside, soaring ceilings and exceptional craftsmanship create a warm, open flow. The great room features spacious living and dining areas anchored by a fireplace, while the chef's kitchen with a large island makes cooking and gathering effortless. Natural light pours in through expansive windows, framing views of patios, pool, gardens, and outdoor entertaining spaces. Three en-suite bedrooms provide spacious retreats with ample closets. A bonus room adds versatility ideal as a fourth bedroom, office, gym, or creative studio. The septic system is 4 bedroom so you have the ability to have an additional bedroom. With world-class wineries, restaurants, and shops just around the corner, this Eastside Sonoma gem offers the rare chance to enjoy it all...privacy, luxury, and proximity to the best of Wine Country.

Welcome to this charming, 2-storied single-family home, built in 2002 with a desirable floor plan, and tasteful upgrades in a prime location, with top-rated schools. Family & kid-friendly community. This versatile living with a high ceiling living room, open-layout family room & kitchen, with 3 bedrooms & 2.5 baths maximizes interior space and comfort living.This well-cared & bright home features an inviting entry, gourmet-inspired kitchen with granite countertops, SS appliances, gas range, large master suite, spacious bedrooms, laminate wood floor all around, new interior paint, large windows, recessed lights, central heat/Ac, 2-car garage with custom build cabinets & epoxy. Fenced low-maintenance backyard, perfect for gardening & entertaining. Ideal location! Walk to well-known Emerald Glen Park, scenic trails, all local amenities, shopping centers, and outlets. Minutes to BART, I-580/680/84 FWYs. Convenience to employers - Kaiser, Workday & more. **Top Rated Schools- James Dougherty Elementary School, Eleanor Murray Fallon Middle School & Emrald High School

Welcome to this turn-key, beautiful, and spacious four-bedroom and three-bathroom home located in the south-central part of Eastvale. This home is perfect for a regular or a large family (up to 6 bedrooms). The spacious kitchen has plenty of room to cook while entertaining guests, including ample cabinets and counter space, built-in appliances, oven, microwave, large center island, breakfast nook, and opens to a huge family room with a fireplace and media niche. There are plenty of windows with natural lighting throughout the home. The wooden shutters add a touch of elegance. A sliding glass door leads to the backyard covered patio for effortless indoor-outdoor living. This special Solid Alumawood Patio Cover is worth mentioning, which features duracool 32' L, 13' W, 10'6 H, double 3 x8 w/steel C beams header, 3 standard H posts @9' HT, Electrical: 1 Fan beam, 2 outlets on two sides posts, and 4 recessed lights on the top ceiling, all approved and inspected by the city of Eastvale (paper included). Another family room door also provides easy access to the garden. A large office next to the family room can be converted into a 5th bedroom. The formal dining room is next to the kitchen, and the living room is on the right side of the entrance. Upstairs, the master suite captures sweeping views, includes dual sinks, a soaking tub, a walk-in shower, a separate restroom, and a spacious walk-in closet. There are three suitable bedrooms, a dual-sink bathroom, and a bonus room which can be converted into a 6th bedroom. The laundry room is a good size with cabinetry and a utility sink. Additional features include a water softener, drinking water equipment, remote control ceiling fans/lights, heated restroom seats, and wooden shutters, providing a more comfortable home life. The rear yard is designed for both relaxation and entertaining, featuring auto pipe sprinklers throughout the entire garden, a variety of flowers, trees, and fruit trees, as well as a grassy area that provides a delight to behold, one that one never tires of admiring in the mornings and evenings. Close to park, trails, award-winning schools, shopping, freeways, and other supporting facilities.

listings.address: 350 Conifer Close Rd, The Sea Ranch, CA 95497
listings.description: Light-filled and contemporary, this Sea Ranch home offers sweeping ocean views, privacy, and effortless indoor-outdoor living. Expansive windows throughout invite natural light to pour in, enhancing the warm wood finishes and open-beam ceilings. The home features beautiful hardwood oak flooring, a wood-burning fireplace with hearth, and a charming built-in window seat perfect for relaxing with a book or enjoying sunset views. The spacious dining area with soaring ceilings easily accommodates both formal gatherings and casual everyday meals. A family room or home office is located off the dining area. The view-oriented kitchen is thoughtfully designed with stainless steel appliances, gas range, double sink, and a breakfast bar with seating for four. A convenient half bath serves the main living areas, and a sliding glass door opens to an ocean-view deck is ideal for entertaining or morning coffee. The primary suite offers abundant light, dual vanities, a tiled walk-in shower with glass doors, and a generous walk-in closet. A private guest bedroom with built-in window seat provides a comfortable retreat, complemented by a guest bath with dual vanity and shower-over-tub. Outdoor spaces include multiple decks and a hot tub for relaxing under the stars. A detached garage with storage, partially fenced yard, and extra parking add flexibility and function. Located on a quiet cul-de-sac, the home has been thoughtfully maintained with a newly installed 50-year roof, fresh exterior staining, and 6 kw solar system with 19.8 kw of battery backup for energy efficiency. A wonderful opportunity to enjoy the best of Sea Ranch coastal living.

Set within a gated Moorpark enclave and backing to open space, this residence offers a rare balance of privacy, design, and effortless California living. Thoughtfully renovated throughout with 5 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, a bonus room framed by French doors, plus a spacious loft with built-in desks, this exceptional home delivers both sophistication and everyday comfort. An expanded driveway accommodating up to six vehicles-including a three-car attached garage-sets a tone of convenience and luxury. Inside, a light-filled open floor plan creates a seamless connection between the living, dining, and kitchen spaces, designed to support both refined entertaining and relaxed daily living. The kitchen serves as the heart of the home, appointed with quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, modern cabinetry, and clean architectural lines. Gorgeous laminate flooring and curated finishes throughout reflect a comprehensive renovation with an emphasis on warmth, quality, and timeless appeal. The layout is intentionally designed for flexibility and privacy. Three bedrooms are located on the main level, including a serene primary suite featuring a remodeled en-suite bath and a custom walk-in closet. Two additional downstairs bedrooms share a beautifully updated hallway bathroom. A separate enclosed room framed by French doors offers versatility as a private office, formal dining room, library or playroom. Upstairs, a generous loft with built-in workstations provides a refined space for study or remote work, accompanied by two bedrooms connected by a well-designed and completely renovated shared bathroom with dual access. The backyard is a true retreat. Backing to open space, the setting offers exceptional privacy and natural beauty. A newly completed pool and spa anchor the outdoor experience, while a detached outdoor pavilion creates an elegant destination for alfresco dining, relaxation, or evening gatherings. Additional highlights include all new windows, custom lighting, freshly painted interior, newer HVAC system, a new water heater, and professional hard scape and landscaping in front and back! This exceptional home offers high quality upgrades and perfect condition, truly one of a kind. The ideal location offers tranquility and convenience-easy access to the freeway, top-rated schools, shopping, and dining. A home that feels both elevated and livable, designed for those who value quality, privacy, and timeless design.

Welcome to this beautifully remodeled 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath home in the highly sought-after community of Arroyo Vista. Set on an expansive quarter-acre lot with open views, this exceptional property offers the perfect blend of style, comfort & functionality. The versatile floor plan includes a dedicated first-floor office and an additional 200-sq-ft bonus room, ideal for work, play, or guests. The stunning kitchen has been thoughtfully updated with new cabinetry, countertops, and appliances, and opens seamlessly to the inviting family room with fireplace, perfect for everyday living and entertaining. Recent upgrades include brand-new Milgard windows, fresh interior paint, solar, a tankless water heater, whole-home water filtration, new A/C, and much more. Upstairs, all four bedrooms provide comfort and privacy. The spacious primary suite captures beautiful views and features a retreat area, a newly remodeled spa-inspired bath, and dual walk-in closets. Step outside to enjoy a private backyard with no rear neighbors, creating a peaceful setting to relax and take in stunning sunsets. The pool-sized lot includes a built-in BBQ and a generous firepit area, ideal for gatherings and outdoor living. Conveniently located within walking distance to elementary, middle, and high schools, and just minutes from shopping, dining, and beaches, this home truly offers the best of lifestyle and location.

listings.address: 5116 Titleist Way, El Dorado Hills, CA 95762
listings.description: Experience refined living in this beautifully maintained 3 BD, 2.5 BA home in the prestigious gated Serrano community, built by Parker Development Company. Ideally positioned near the golf course, scenic trails, parks, top-rated schools, Serrano Country Club, and just minutes to Town Center and Folsom amenities, this home offers the best of El Dorado Hills living. Soaring cathedral ceilings, oversized windows, and louvered shutters create a bright, elegant atmosphere throughout. A private office near the entry offers flexibility as a third bedroom, den, or library. The guest suite with en suite bath is thoughtfully placed opposite the primary suite for privacy. The immaculate kitchen leads to both a formal dining room, and to an inviting family room with wet barperfect for hosting gatherings. Step outside to a pergola-covered patio designed for relaxed evenings and outdoor dining. With access from both the family room and primary suite, indoor-outdoor living feels seamless. Meticulously cared for and move-in ready, this home presents a rare opportunity in one of Serrano's most desirable neighborhoods.

EXECUTIVE HOME | PANORAMIC VIEWS | GUARDED+GATED | REMODELLED KITCHEN | DOWNSTAIRS BEDROOM | OPEN CONCEPT | 3-CAR GARAGE | CUL-DE-SAC | Discover the epitome of elegance in this executive residence, known as the Fountain House, located in the prestigious gated community of The Retreat. Step into the expansive private front courtyard, highlighted by two tranquil fountains - an inviting space to welcome friends or spend peaceful mornings. The custom double-door entry welcomes you into a grand formal entryway leading to the Living Room and adjacent Dining Room, creating an ideal setting for those special gatherings. The Chef's Kitchen features a large island, breakfast bar seating, granite countertops, walk-in pantry, butler's pantry, coffee station, upgraded cabinetry (2023) with soft close doors/drawers, JennAir stainless steel appliances, & double French doors to the spacious backyard - perfect for entertaining any size of gathering. The open-concept Family Room features a gas fireplace and endless windows for panoramic views of snow-capped mountains & end-of-day sunset colors. A convenient downstairs Bedroom + full bath is perfect for multi-gen living or guests. Ascend the sweeping staircase to find your oversized Primary Bedroom with its spa-inspired ensuite - deep soaking tub, dual sinks, oversized walk-in shower, and generous walk-in closet. Bedrooms 3 and 4 are well-sized with a nearby full bathroom, while the expansive Loft is a perfect flex space for office, media room, or play area. A dedicated Laundry Room has folding station, utility sink, and ample cabinets. Ahhhh ....the Backyard! It's a private oasis featuring gorgeous mountain views, built-in BBQ island with ample bar-top seating, your own custom waterfall and even a private vineyard, all set within a fully landscaped, pool-sized yard. ADDITIONAL UPGRADES: Beautiful luxury flooring (2021), gorgeous plantation shutters (2021), soft water system, new carpet (2024), & fresh exterior paint (2023). LOCATION: Walk to nearby playground, park and basketball court, or stroll the walking trails. Ideally situated near Trader Joe's, Starbucks, Amazon Fresh and Dos Lagos Shopping Center for cinemas, shopping, restaurants, music venues & more! Quick access to 15/91 Expressways, 71 Fwy, & 241 Toll Road to OC. With its refined finishes, serene spaces, and prime location, this remarkable home delivers the lifestyle you've been dreaming about!

The one that checks all the boxes!! East Facing 11-year-new single-family home with 1 bed and a full bathroom downstairs and 3 additional bedrooms upstairs. Enjoy being the favorite host in your gourmet kitchen with a large island. Huge windows with abundant natural light and soaring ceilings. Fully Owned Solar Panels. Spacious upstairs loft for additional office space or play area. Gorgeous views of the sunset over the green belt from the primary suite of your dreams that also includes a generous walk-in closet and an ensuite bath. A desirable community with a park and all the amenities nearby. This one is a true commuter's delight with an unbeatable location. When was the last time you saw a home you liked so much?? Experience the best of Milpitas!!

Looking for the perfect mountain home? This one brings together every Tahoe essentialindooroutdoor living with floor-to-ceiling sliders, mountain-peak views, natural light throughout, a large multilevel entertainment patio, a bunk room, media room, separate-level living, and dedicated ski lockers! Situated on a spacious .66-acre lot with stunning views of Lookout Mountain, the home takes full advantage of natural light and its scenic surroundings. The great room centers the home with tall ceilings, floor-to-ceiling sliding glass doors, and a layout that opens directly to the outdoors. The large patio extends the living space with a covered outdoor fireplace, kitchen & built-in grill, fire pit, and a hot tub positioned to look out toward Lookout Mountainideal for year-round enjoyment. The kitchen features clean, modern finishes with a central island, premium appliances, a walk-in pantry, and a dining area designed for everyday gathering. The primary suite sits in its own wing with patio and spa access, a spacious bath, and a generous walk-in closet. A second main-level suite also opens to the patio, offering privacy and comfort for guests. Upstairs, a media room offers mountain-peak views and large windows that fill the space with natural light throughout the day. This level also includes an en-suite guest room, as well as a spacious bunk room with its own dedicated bathroom. From the garage, enjoy easy access to a dedicated gear area with ski lockers and direct entry to the laundry roomperfect for unloading after a day on the mountain. The oversized three-car garage provides generous space for all your mountain toys and gear. Life in Lahontan adds another layer, with gated access, year-round community amenities, and the Tom Weiskopfdesigned championship and par-3 golf courses. For added privacy or long-term planning, the adjacent parcel at 7760 Lahontan Drive is also available.

Welcome to this 5 bedroom, 7 bathroom home nestled within the exclusive, resort-style Deerlake Ranch community. This newer-construction residence blends modern luxury with thoughtful design and eco-conscious living. With paid-off solar panels, this spacious home offers exceptional comfort, high-end upgrades, and timeless elegance. Step through a grand entryway into a bright, expansive floor plan featuring soaring ceilings and custom window treatments throughout. The main level includes a private guest suite with a full en-suite bath, ideal for multigenerational living or visiting guests. A dedicated home office and walk-in pantry add functionality to the home's stunning design. At the heart of the home is a chef's dream kitchen, complete with sleek quartz countertops, premium KitchenAid built-in appliances, and sophisticated modern finishes. Entertain effortlessly in the open-concept living and dining areas or step outside to a beautifully designed backyard retreat featuring low-maintenance turf and a built-in fire pit-perfect for year-round enjoyment. Each of the upstairs bedrooms boasts its own en-suite bathroom, ensuring privacy and comfort for every member of the household. The lavish primary suite is a true sanctuary, featuring a private balcony with scenic views, a spa-inspired bathroom with a freestanding soaking tub, dual vanities, and his-and-hers walk-in closets.Additional features include a built-in surround sound system, smart home capabilities, and premium designer touches throughout. This exceptional home offers both elegance and convenience in one of the area's most desirable communities. Residents of Deerlake Ranch enjoy access to premium community amenities, including a recreation center with 3 separate sections, pool/spa center and a dog park-designed for both convenience and lifestyle.

listings.address: 79840 Rancho La Quinta Dr, La Quinta, CA 92253
listings.description: Discover the perfect blend of luxury, privacy, and resort-style living in this beautifully upgraded 4 bedroom, 4 bath Encanto ll home, ideally situated on the 2nd fairway of the Pate Golf Course-one of two at Rancho La Quinta Country Club. Step through the gated front entry into a peaceful courtyard with a soothing water feature and a newly re-done two bedroom guest casita with jack and jill bath and new porcelain flooring, which offers comfort and privacy for guests or your own dedicated retreat space. Inside the main home, you'll find a spacious formal living room and dining area with soaring ceilings and a dramatic fireplace, perfect for entertaining or cozy evenings by the fire. The stunning great room invites casual elegance, featuring a sleek slate-style fireplace, with a large media TV, and open flow into the newly renovated gourmet kitchen. Designed for both beauty and function, the kitchen boasts a luxury porcelain island countertops and backsplash by Costentino, which are matte finished, new double ovens with air fry and Sous Vide, plus a French door refrigerator. The main residence includes two bedrooms, including a luxurious Primary Suite with spa-like bath, dual vanities, and a spacious shower. A well appointed guest bedroom and bathroom complete the layout along with a powder room. Enjoy seamless indoor-outdoor living with a resort-style backyard featuring an infinity-edge Pebble-Tec pool with sun shelf, built-in BBQ area, and breathtaking views of the lake and fairway. The elevated lot provides added privacy while maximizing the scenery. This home has been meticulously maintained and includes new porcelain counters in kitchen and hall, new double ovens, new refrigerator, new washer and dryer, and outdoor and interior painting. Also, some new windows, new 2 speed pool pump and salt system cells. New cabinet hardware and plumbing fixtures throughout. Upgraded baseboards, new wall switches, numerous new light fixtures, NEST's throughout, new garage door, openers and outdoor putting green. Offered furnished per inventory, this exquisite home is ready for you to enjoy the best of desert living at Rancho La Quinta Country Club. See attached Improvement and Inventory Lists.

Stunning 2025 rebuild in the highly desirable Strawberry neighborhood of Mill Valley. Designed for modern living, this home features soaring ceilings, expansive custom windows, European white oak floors, custom cabinetry, and wide hallways perfect for everyday comfort and kids at play. The single-level main residence offers 3 bedrooms and 2 baths, plus an attached 1-bedroom, 2-bath ADU with private and interior access, creating a flexible 4BR/4BA layout ideal for guests, extended family, or a home office. Chef's kitchen with top-of-the-line Thermador appliances, oversized island, and walk-in pantry opens to bright living and dining areas anchored by a modern limestone plaster fireplace. Sliding doors lead to a spacious deck and a grassy backyard with a private, fully enclosed fence ideal for entertaining and safe outdoor play. Luxurious primary suite with spa-style bath, large walk-in closet, and private deck. Short walk to Strawberry Point Elementary School, playground, recreation center, waterfront trail, shopping, and dining. Minutes to downtown Mill Valley and Tiburon with easy freeway access.

Welcome to Dominion, an intimate gated enclave of just 14 contemporary residences set across more than eight beautifully landscaped acres and framed by breathtaking southwest mountain views. The community offers a rare combination of architectural presence, privacy, and open space. Inside, more than 4, 000 square feet of living space is defined by soaring ceilings and expansive entertaining areas designed to feel both impressive and inviting. A gracious formal living room and dining room anchor the home, each lined with sliding glass walls that open to the outdoors, creating seamless indoor-outdoor living and filling the interiors with natural light. The heart of the residence is a true chef's kitchen, featuring Wolf and Sub-Zero appliances, dual dishwashers, custom cabinetry, granite countertops, a walk-in pantry, and a generous center island. The kitchen opens naturally to the family room and breakfast area, while a well-placed wet bar connecting the family and dining rooms enhances both casual gatherings and formal entertaining. The home offers four ensuite bedrooms, one being a private detached guest house complete with wet bar, walk-in closet, and bathideal for guests or extended stays. A stylish powder bathroom with floating vanity and vessel sink adds a contemporary touch. The primary suite serves as a peaceful retreat, capturing southern mountain views and offering a spa-inspired bath with dual vanities, roman soaking tub, separate shower, and a spacious walk-in closets. Travertine flooring throughout the living areas and premium carpeting in the bedrooms provide warmth and timeless sophistication. Outdoors, the backyard becomes a private resort. A saline pool and spa are set against panoramic mountain views, complemented by an outdoor BBQ island, fireplace lounge area, all surrounded by mature custom landscaping for exceptional privacy. Additional amenities include an oversized three-car garage, providing generous storage and convenience. Located just minutes from El Paseo's renowned boutiques, galleries, and dining, this residence blends architectural style, indoor-outdoor living, and exclusivity in one of the desert's most intimate communities.

listings.address: 1214 Carmel St, San Luis Obispo, CA 93401
listings.description: This elegant luxury townhouse is in downtown San Luis Obispo, dubbed "America's Happiest Place" by Oprah Winfrey in 2011. City conveniences-including restaurants, cafes, pubs, the San Luis Mission, plaza, museums, theaters, and shops-are all within walking distance. Central Coast wineries, beaches, and Hwy 101 access are nearby, as are shopping malls, farmers markets, and hiking trails. Inside this contemporary Spanish-inspired home, natural light and high-end finishes abound. The open-concept floorplan features three bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms across 2,285 sq. ft., with 9-foot ceilings and a gourmet kitchen with premium appliances. All four levels are accessible by stairs or a private elevator. Rebuilt in 2025 with new windows, walls, insulation, and upgrades by a respected local builder, the home includes custom touches by one owner, a luxury interior designer, making it move-in ready. High-end features include fumed white oak wide-plank floors, matching stair treads, Italian tile, tankless water heater, three-zone HVAC, Weather Shield windows, premium appliances, Sonos sound, automated security gate, mesh Wi-Fi, and Google Nest systems. The ground floor offers a stylish entry with designer wall coverings, Spanish lighting, Italian tile, custom closet, privacy-glass door, and upgraded lighting. The two-car garage has resin flooring, built-in storage, and key fob/pad entry. The first floor kitchen boasts Sub-Zero and Wolf appliances, quartzite counters, Italian tile backsplash, a center island, reverse osmosis water filtration, automated window shades, and a custom pantry with coffee bar and Wolf microwave drawer. The open living/dining area features natural light, chandelier, custom fireplace tile with barn beam mantel, built-in cabinetry, Juliet balcony, elevator access, and a powder room. The second floor has two guest ensuite bedrooms with custom closets, upgraded lighting, and Italian porcelain tile bathrooms with quartzite countertops. A dedicated laundry area offers extra cabinetry. The third floor hosts the luxurious primary suite with terrace access, designer wall coverings, automated window coverings, Samsung TV with Sonos sound, and sophisticated lighting. The customized walk-in closet includes built-in storage, pop-up charging dresser, beverage fridge, coffee station, and wine storage. Now is the time to schedule a private tour of this exceptional property.

New construction completed February 2026 with 10 Year Builder Warranty for structural integrity included! 3,477 sq ft of refined living space, including a junior accessory dwelling unit (JADU). This exceptional home offers 6 bedrooms, 5 bathrooms, and a bonus yoga room/home office, all presented in a contemporary design with custom cabinetry throughout. A stunning 20-foot entry and living room set a dramatic tone, complemented by 10 to 12 foot ceilings and extra-large windows that flood the interiors with natural light and deliver timeless elegance. The kitchen, dining, and living areas flow effortlessly to an elevated rear deck and beautifully landscaped groundsideal for seamless indoor-outdoor living. Expansive balconies showcase breathtaking views of the Evergreen Hills, creating the perfect backdrop for entertaining or unwinding. A thoughtfully integrated JADU provides valuable flexibility for multigenerational living, guest quarters, or independent space. Enjoy a prime location within walking distance to award-winning Silver Creek High School, as well as nearby library and parksperfect for an active, connected lifestyle. Built with intention. Designed for long-term livability.

Welcome to your serene mountain retreat in Tahoe Donner, where attention to detail and pride of ownership shine. Light and bright throughout with a beautiful backyard setting and expansive mountain views off your kitchen and dining room. Thoughtful updates throughout include maple hardwood floors, vaulted pine ceilings, tiled baths, and newer kitchen and laundry appliances. The open-concept great room is perfect for gatherings, featuring a blend of warm wood, stone, and stainless finishes. Recent enhancementsover $200K in totalinclude a new roof (2024), updated decks, new windows, and French doors that open to the outdoors. Enjoy seamless indoor-outdoor living on the wrap-around deck, ideal for morning coffee or evenings under the stars. Perfectly positioned near Tahoe Donners ski hill, Alder Creek, golf, and trails, and just minutes to downtown Truckee, this home offers effortless comfort and year-round Tahoe enjoyment

listings.address: 18320 Via Ambiente, Rancho Santa Fe, CA 92067
listings.description: Awe inspiring views of the canyons & the ocean await you from this private estate located in the coveted gated community of Cielo. This timeless custom Dena Gillespie home is perched on a large lot seamlessly blending indoor/outdoor living with first class appointments. With several view decks, a jacuzzi spilling into the salt water pool, built-in BBQ, large covered dining area, built-in bar, putting green & fire-pit, it's the kind of dream yard that feels like a quiet escape. The interior of the home is brimming with exceptional finishes & fine craftsmanship. Recently updated chef's kitchen with quartzite countertops, large prep island, Wolf range, SubZero refrigerator/freezer, butlers pantry & wine room with etched glass & custom wrought iron door. For those seeking serenity, escape to the main floor primary suite with a cozy fireplace, heated bathroom floors, steam shower, lavish bathtub, sauna & picturesque windows to soak in the views. Additional amenities include tumbled travertine flooring, all new chandeliers throughout, 4 en-suite guest bedrooms (one on the main level), an upstairs temperature controlled wine room, oversized 3 car garage, Lutron lighting system & Aqualink system for the pool to easily manage from your phone or tablet. Situated in the award winning Rancho Santa Fe school district. The community of Cielo has world-class amenities including 24 hour gate guarded security, an Olympic-sized pool, state-of-the-art gym, 2 tennis courts, pickleball, nature trails, beautiful parks & an indoor/outdoor entertaining area.

Stunning home built in 2019; almost 4400 sq.ft., open & bright, tall ceiling throughout. Over 13,000 sq.ft. of one of the deepest/largest lots in Willow Glen. 5 bedrooms (formal living room with barn doors can be used as office or 6th room) including a guest bedroom with en-suite bath on the ground level. Formal dining room with double sliding glass doors to side porch + wine cellar with glass wall. Great room with double sliding glass doors to extra-deep rear yard with lawn, deck & patios. Open chef's kitchen features island with counter seating, marble-style quartz counters; high-end Thermador appliances including built-in refrigerator, gas range with 6 burners + 2 ovens; banquette-style casual dining. Primary suite has walk-in closet; en-suite spa-like bath with separate vanities, freestanding tub, frameless glass shower, private commode room. Additional bedroom with en suite bath, plus 2 bedrooms sharing Jack-and-Jill bath. Accessed from a rear staircase or hidden bookshelf door from primary suite closet, is an extra-large flexible-use room with 2 walk-in closets, cathedral ceiling, and half-bath. Powder room; mudroom; laundry room with sink, washer & dryer; attached 2-car garage wired for EV charging; tankless water heater; multi-zone air conditioning. Close to Downtown WG.

listings.address: 1050 Hogarth Way, El Dorado Hills, CA 95762
listings.description: Tucked inside the prestigious, gated Serrano community, this stunning golf course residence offers an open, airy great room concept with the convenience of mostly single-story living. The well-appointed kitchen features stainless steel appliances, a walk-in pantry, and seamless flow into the main living and dining areasideal for both everyday living and entertaining. The upper level includes one bedroom, one full bathroom, a bonus area, and a balconyperfect for guests or added flexibility. Two fireplaces add warmth and character, while expansive windows capture peaceful fairway views. Thoughtfully upgraded with smart home features and a tankless water heater, the home blends modern efficiency with everyday comfort. The backyard is designed for year-round enjoyment with a built-in pool and spa, covered patio, and built-in barbecueideal for relaxing or entertaining. Additional highlights include a three-car garage with epoxy floors and owned solar for energy efficiency. A rare opportunity to enjoy comfort, privacy, and resort-style living in one of Serrano's most sought-after gated communities.

listings.address: 5630 Grazing Hill Rd, Shingle Springs, CA 95682
listings.description: Spectacular and truly custom, this 10+ acre gated Legacy Ranch with two homes presents a rare architectural marvel with sweeping views of the Sacramento city lights and the snowcapped Sierra Nevada Mountains. Designed by renowned environmental architect David Wright, the estate is thoughtfully patterned after the classic Australian Ranch style, defined by openness, material integrity, and a strong connection to the surrounding landscape. The design features an expansive open floor plan, corrugated metal roofing with 6-inch solid copper gutters and accents, and distinctive copper elements woven throughout the estate, including patina-finished chimney caps and custom interior detailing. Sustainability is integral, with alternative energy strategies such as a concrete slab floor and structural insulated panel walls, as well as a superior owned solar system with Tesla batteries, and a backup generator. Circulating radiant floor heating delivers year-round comfort with efficiency and economy. The main home offers over 4,600 square feet of refined indoor/outdoor living and is organized around an open courtyard with patio, pool, spa, gas fire pit, and built-in BBQ. Interiors include four en suite bedrooms, an office, wood-cased dual-pane windows and a 16-foot walk-in vault with solid concrete block construction and built-in cabinetry. The interior experience is both bold and unexpected. At the center of the home is a dramatic entertaining bar with granite counters, copper sink, floating bar stools, refrigerator, clear ice maker, and dishwasher. The chef's kitchen is appointed with a dual-fuel Dacor range with six-burner cooktop, built-in refrigerator, double sinks, cherrywood cabinetry, and a spacious pantry accented with stained glass. Infrastructure includes a four-car attached garage, a six-car detached garage with an oversized 60' x 44' drive-through motorhome bay, and an additional detached RV & boat drive-through garage. The grounds feature a three-stall barn with power, fenced and cross-fenced pastures, paddock areas with triple-rail vinyl fencing, a fenced garden, and an olive tree orchard. Completing the estate is a 700-square-foot guest home, designed to match the main residence, offering a spacious living room, bedroom, and full bathroom, ideal for extended family, guests, or a property caretaker. This legacy ranch of architectural distinction was built with intention, and impossible to replicate.

ACCEPTING BACKUP OFFERS -An exceptional opportunity to own a truly one-of-a-kind 2.3-acre property in the heart of Bermuda Dunes. This versatile estate features an expansive 9,600-square-foot insulated clear-span shop, complete with a built-in two-bedroom, two-bath fully equipped apartment and a bonus open-air deck--ideal for live/work flexibility or hobbies. The shop offers four 14' x 14' automatic roll-up bays and an additional half bath, providing outstanding functionality and access. The property also includes a walled in custom one-bedroom, one-and-a-half-bath residence showcasing a beautifully appointed kitchen with nostalgic Heartland appliances, an open great-room concept, and abundant natural light. Large windows and sliding glass doors open to lush landscaping, a sparkling pebble-tech pool and spa, and serene outdoor living spaces. The primary suite features dual sinks, a walk-in shower, a spacious closet, and an in-home washer and dryer. A two-car garage completes the residence. Additional highlights include three RV hookup sites, an RV dump station, mature citrus trees, and ample space to build a larger custom home if desired. Conveniently located with easy access to surrounding cities, freeway connections, dining, and shopping, this rare property truly offers endless possibilities. Come experience all this remarkable property has to offer.

For a moment, you have to remind yourself that youre in the great room, not the great outdoors. Or is it both? As the southwest corner of wraparound pocket windows disappear from the great room of this Martis Camp home, the line between the indoors and out completely vanishes. What youre left with is both a sense of calm and a setting thats ideal for entertaining. Beyond are soaring pine trees and the allure of meandering Putting Park greens just steps from the back patio. That picture is upon you the moment you ascend the stairs to a sunny, inspiring living space with kitchen, dining room and great room and up an elegant custom staircase an office loft that seems to levitate in the towering windows. From this perch, the 3rd and 4th hole of the Martis Camp 18-hole Putting Park unfolds below you and Lookout Mountain rises in the distance. The living area shares this view and has immediate access to the patio with firepit and hot tub. Further down the hallway of this 5-bedroom, 4.5 bathroom, 3, 250 square foot home is a bedroom and the primary suite, both with access to a hot tub with Putting Park views. Midway down the main staircase is another level that leads to a bedroom, office/5th bedroom and junior suite. The patio that encircles this home calls to you to grab your putter and golf balls and make the 30-second stroll to the greens of the acclaimed Dick Bailey designed Putting Course. And if its working up a sweat that youre in search of, theres a separate entrance to an area not far from the entrance thats been converted into a gym and dry sauna. Stretch your legs a bit more and youll find yourself at the Park Pavilion, Pickle Ball courts, and sports field and just a bit farther is Concert Lake and the adjacent Family Barn, just a few of the many amenities that recently led Forbes to write, At Martis Camp, you can have the home of your dreams in a community that perhaps even your wildest imagination hasnt dreamed of yet. The appliances of this home are as impressive as its views and location. The great room features a local quarried stone fireplace, radiant heated Brazilian slate floors, walnut cabinetry and a gourmet Thermador professional series kitchen. Flooring is European white oak, cabinets, trim and doors are walnut, and theres an abundance of energy efficient components like Thermador Energy Star appliances, Icynene insulation, and a Rheem Electronic Air Cleaner that captures and removes 99.7% of all pollutant air particles. A Martis Camp golf membership is associated with this property.

Step into a lifestyle defined by effortless elegance and architectural brilliance within the highly sought-after Enclave at Sunrise. This meticulously maintained contemporary home offers a masterclass in indoor-outdoor living, where every room reflects intentional design and a refined attention to detail. As you pass through the gated courtyard that has been professionally landscaped, you are greeted by an expansive open-concept floor plan with 10' ceilings, anchored by a stunning floor-to-ceiling fireplace and beautiful tiled flooring found throughout the home. The heart of the home is an epicurean designer kitchen featuring premium integrated appliances, quartz countertops, and a massive center island designed to serve as the ultimate social hub for friends and family. Beyond the glass sliders lies your own private resort oasis, where the majestic San Jacinto Mountains provide a dramatic backdrop to a world-class backyard. Spend your afternoons lounging by the sparkling pool and spa, engaging in a spirited game of bocce ball or putting on your private greens. As dusk falls, the landscape comes alive with strategic custom lighting, while a fire pit and lighted pool set the mood for a zen evening under the stars. The primary suite serves as a sanctuary of indulgence, offering a sitting area, expansive walk-in closets, and a spa-like bath featuring a deep soaking tub, spacious walk-in shower. The second private guest bedroom is en-suite and the third guest bedroom is currently being used as an office/den/media room with pull down projector and screen. This residence is as intelligent as it is beautiful, equipped with owned solar, Tesla backup batteries, smart-home technology, a saltwater softening system for the whole home and automated window treatments in each bedroom. Whether you are hosting an al fresco dinner on the covered patio or retreating to the private guest suites, this home offers a rare blend of sustainable, eco-conscious living and high-end luxury in a league of its own.

listings.address: 2466 Falcon Valley Dr, Chula Vista, CA 91914
listings.description: This remarkable Salt Creek Ranch home in family friendly Rolling Hills Ranch offers multi-generational living spaces from the front porch seating with its lovely views to the EZ to care for back yard with Fruit trees, an open space view and lunches or bar b ques under the newer patio overhang. This 4/3 offers a bedroom downstairs for guests or in-laws, along with beautifully tall ceilings in the entryway-Living Room/Dining Room. Stained glass windows add to the beauty as do the wall insets for special artwork. This well maintained home has newer quartz counters in the kitchen, newly replaced fences on both sides, and room for 3 cars in the garage. Abundant storage throughout the home along with an upstairs laundry room. The oversized primary bedroom features a large walk in closet in this desired floorplan. Located close to freeways, shopping, elementary and middle schools, along with the 5 beautifully maintained pools and 24 acre Salt Creek Park that offers a gym, skate park, soccer, tennis courts, walking trails and so much more.

This architectural gem in Pasadena's prestigious Chapman Woods neighborhood offers timeless craftsmanship, generous scale, and serene surroundings. Designed by renowned architect Don Lee and custom built in 2005, the single-story residence spans 6,113 square feet on a lush 37,905-square-foot lot.Set behind an expansive front yard, the home's commanding stone porch welcomes you into a foyer that opens to formal living and family rooms, each overlooking the tranquil backyard. A long, light-filled hallway with soaring ceilings and multiple skylights creates a stunning central axis for the home. Throughout, vaulted ceilings, dramatic floor-to-ceiling windows, and exquisite details--including custom copper gutters and Japanese-imported rain chains--reflect the quality of design and construction.The thoughtful floor plan includes five spacious bedrooms and seven bathrooms, with each bedroom enjoying its own ensuite. Two primary suites, each overlooking private zen gardens, create retreat-like sanctuaries. Additional spaces include a dedicated craft room, office, wine closet, and formal dining room. The open-concept kitchen and adjoining family room make the home ideal for entertaining, while the formal living room--with its grand fireplace--adds timeless elegance.Outdoors, a large covered patio overlooks a waterfall and goldfish pond, creating a serene backdrop for gatherings. A four-car garage, expansive front lawn, and mature landscaping complete this rare offering.A statement of refined living in Chapman Woods, this estate blends architectural pedigree with warmth, comfort, and enduring quality.

Welcome to a truly special home! The tone is set from the moment you step inside, with soaring 18'ft ceilings in the great room, rich wood plank floors & an oversized isokern fireplace this wide-open layout creates a seamless flow throughout. The spacious chef's kitchen is built for hosting with its 6-burner Thermador range, double ovens, oversized island, butler's pantry & custom cabinets. The split floorplan features all en-suite bedrooms, each with walk-in closets & a flex bonus room with space for an office, gym or game room. The primary suite adds a special touch with oversized walk-in closets & spa like ensuite. Enjoy indoor/outdoor living w/ the four-panel sliding patio door that opens to a resort backyard, salt water pool, built for year-round enjoyment. Stunning mountain views! negative-edge pool with a chiller system for warmer summer days, & a relaxing spa. Imagine sitting around the fire pit while watching the mountain ranges shift colors at sunset. The property includes a private well, fully fenced backyard w/ snake proofing, & the acreage provides space for horses, a casita, shop or RV garage. No HOA, Not in the Flood zone. Milgard Aluminum Windows, Custom Cabinets throughout...the upgrades are endless!

Stunning custom home in North Scottsdale situated on over an acre with NO HOA, paved road access with a great producing well and a resort-style backyard and pool. Upon entry, you'll notice soaring 10-12 ft ceilings throughout and a desirable split floor plan. The home features 4 spacious bedrooms plus an office/den and 4 luxurious bathrooms. In addition to the primary, 2 other bedrooms are ensuite, with one offering a larger walk in closet and private patio access. Designed for entertaining, the gourmet kitchen showcases custom cabinetry, quartz countertops, a gas range/oven, and a butler's pantry. The primary suite is a private retreat with a soaking tub, large walk-in shower, oversized walk-in closet with access to the laundry room and private patio access. Enjoy true Sonoran living with a large multi-slide glass door leading to the expansive patio and backyard complete with a pool featuring a Baja bench, travertine decking, and turf. Take in panoramic mountain views, including Four Peaks, from the rooftop deck. The oversized pull-through RV garage is fully insulated and complemented by an additional oversized 2-car garage. Wired for an electric vehicle charger. Energy-efficient features include spray foam insulation (including garage) and dual-pane windows. This exceptional property offers luxury living and all that North Scottsdale has to offer including world-class hiking, mountain biking, off-roading, horseback riding, etc. straight from the house

Stunning home on the Golf Course in North Scottsdale with some of the best views in all of 85255. Positioned on an expansive, premium lot with panoramic views of the Majestic McDowell Mountains, Pinnacle Peak, Tom's Thumb, and the 14th tee box of Grayhawk's Talon Course. This is a rare opportunity to purchase in the guard-gated Talon Retreat at Grayhawk. Located just a few homes from the end of a tranquil cul-de-sac, this residence has been remodeled and is a rare find in Scottsdale. The east-facing backyard provides stunning morning light and expansive golf course and mountain views enhanced by a floor to ceiling slider providing an incredible indoor outdoor entertainers dream. A built-in barbecue kitchen invites alfresco dining, while the gas firepit sets the mood for cozy evenings The pool features a tranquil waterfall, an in-ground cleaning system, auto refill, and aerator. Artificial turf and a lighted saguaro cactus further enhance the beauty of this resort-style retreat. Home features a chef's dream kitchen! The gourmet kitchen seamlessly opens to the family room, creating the perfect space for gatherings. Featuring a stylish gas cooktop/oven, a Sub-Zero refrigerator and a built in drawer microwave, this space is designed for both function and beauty. The porcelain countertops, backsplash, and custom under-cabinet lighting enhance the luxurious aesthetic. Thoughtful additions such as built in bar and wine fridge provide the perfect combination of convenience and sophistication. Elegant interior & thoughtful upgrades with 12-foot ceilings and solid interior doors throughout, this home exudes grandeur. The primary suite is a tranquil retreat, featuring a private sitting area, French Doors to the patio, a redesigned spa-like bathroom with an luxurious soaking tub, accented by a huge serenity providing picture window. Additional highlights include: New hardwood floors, new tankless hot water heater with built-in recirculation pump (2023), two newer HVAC systems and furnaces (2016/2017), roof replacement (2011), oversized garage with built-in cabinets, epoxy floors, extra insulation, new garage door opener with a camera & keypad, and a 20-amp outlet for added versatility. The home's exterior has been freshly painted (2017) with premium finishes, and all Regal View Low-E windows enhance energy efficiency. About Grayhawk: A Premier Master-Planned Community Located in the heart of North Scottsdale, Grayhawk is one of the Valley's most sought-after luxury communities, offering an unmatched lifestyle with award-winning golf courses, walking and biking trails, community pools, tennis courts, social events, and exclusive homeowner amenities. The Retreat at Grayhawk also provides access to The Grayhawk Buzz e-blast, keeping residents informed about events and community news. Just minutes from world-class shopping, dining, and top-rated schools, this home is ideally positioned for those seeking a blend of privacy, convenience, and resort-style living. This stunning home is a true gem in North Scottsdale's luxury market. Experience the best of golf course living in Grayhawk's exclusive Retreat community!

Experience the pinnacle of sophisticated living in this Massive Custom Renovation and Addition (completed 2021) by renowned SRJ Development. Located in the prime 85254 Magic Zip Code, this estate places you minutes from Kierland, Scottsdale Quarter, and to TPC Scottsdale. Spanning 3, 026 Sq Ft of unified living to the highest luxury standard with 4 Beds and 4 Full Baths. The Modern Farmhouse design showcases dramatic vaulted ceilings with skylights, complemented by cohesive, high-end finishes throughout. The entry features a private Front Courtyard with Mountain Views. The Chef's Kitchen is a command center: Sub Zero 66'' unit, Wolf 48'' Dual Fuel Range (char grill/double ovens), Neolith Stone counters, a 10 10 island with a third Wolf oven, and a Wine Chiller/Humidor. Ad the Hearth Gathering Room: a cozy, central living space featuring an Italian Stone Clad Gas/Wood Burning Fireplace and a Multi Slide Door for seamless indoor-outdoor living. The Split Primary Suite is a sanctuary, featuring a gas fireplace, French doors, and a Spa-Inspired Bath finished in elegant Marble, complete with an Oversized Steam Shower and soaking tub. The backyard oasis includes a Presidential Pool/Spa with Baja Shelf, Entertaining Area with Outdoor Fireplace and Pro Shade Concepts Illuminated Remote Control Awnings. Utility and convenience are maximized with Hardwood Floors, Pella Windows, 2 Tankless Hot Water Heaters, a water softener, 2 Storage Sheds outside, built-in cabinetry in the garage, and a dedicated Electric Car Outlet (EV Charger Ready). App-controlled Level Five perimeter lighting and an owned security system complete this bespoke residence. This isn't just a home; it's a meticulously curated lifestyle, awaiting its discerning owner.
